safi-cedvel:22-24.t:
* I'rab:
(السين) a particle of the future (يقولون) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ)..
and (الواو) is the fāʿil (agent); (ثلاثة) khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "هم"; (رابعهم) mubtadaʾ, nominative..
and (هم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (كلبهم) khabar, nominative.. and (هم) is like the first; (الواو) a conjunction in both places; (يقولون.. كلبهم) like the first; (رجما) a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the agent pronoun in the two preceding verbs «[Note: Or a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, or a mafʿūl muṭlaq standing in for the maṣdar because it is an adjective of it, i.e. "a guessing speech", or its synonym..]», (بالغيب) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (رجما); (يقولون.. كلبهم) like the first, and (الواو) is redundant (zāʾida) before ثامنهم «[Note: Either without emphasis, or to convey emphasis of the adjective's adherence to what it qualifies.. It was also said that it is a conjunction, not redundant.. And some exegetes said it is the wāw of the ḥāl, i.e.: they say that, while their eighth is their dog. Ibn Hishām rejected that it is the "wāw of eight" as some grammarians stated.]», (قل) an imperative verb, and the agent is "you" (أنت); (ربّي أعلم) like ربّنا ربّ «[Note: In verse (14) of this sūra.]», and the sign of the nominative of ربّي is the implied ḍamma on the letter before the yāʾ; (بعدّتهم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أعلم), and (هم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (ما) negative; (يعلمهم) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and (هم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (إلّا) a particle of restriction; (قليل) the agent of يعلمهم, nominative; (الفاء) linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition; (لا) prohibitive, making jussive; (تمار) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), and the sign of the jussive is the dropping of the weak letter.. and the agent is "you"; (في) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (تمار); (إلّا) like the first; (مراء) mafʿūl muṭlaq, accusative (manṣūb); (ظاهرا) naʿt (adjective) of مراء, accusative; (الواو) a conjunction; (لا تستفت) like لا تمار; (فيهم) like the first, attached to a ḥāl of (أحدا); (منهم) like فيهم, attached to (تستفت); (أحدا) mafʿūl bihi, accusative.
The clause «يقولون ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «(هم) ثلاثة ...» is in the position of the accusative as the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «رابعهم كلبهم ...» is in the position of the nominative as an adjective of ثلاثة.
The clause «يقولون (the second) ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «(هم) خمسة ...» is in the position of the accusative as the object of saying.
The clause «سادسهم كلبهم ...» is in the position of the nominative as an adjective of خمسة.
The clause «يقولون (the third)» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «(هم) سبعة ...» is in the position of the accusative as the object of saying.
The clause «ثامنهم كلبهم ...» is in the position of the nominative as an adjective of سبعة «[Note: Or conjoined to the clause هم سبعة.]».
The clause «قل ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «ربّي أعلم ...» is in the position of the accusative as the object of saying.
The clause «يعلمهم إلّا قليل» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «لا تمار ...» is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e. "if you speak about them, then do not dispute".
The clause «لا تستفت ...» is in the position of the jussive, conjoined to the clause لا تمار.
23- (الواو) a conjunction; (لا تقولنّ) like لا يشعرنّ «[Note: Verse (19).]», and the agent is "you"; (لشيء) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تقولنّ), and the (اللام) means "for the sake of"; (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb, and (الياء) a pronoun in the position of the accusative as the noun of inna; (فاعل) the khabar of inna, nominative; (ذلك) a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the accusative as the direct object of the active participle.. and (اللام) is for distance and (الكاف) for address; (غدا) an adverb of time, accusative, attached to (فاعل).
The clause «لا تقولنّ ...» is in the position of the jussive, conjoined to the clause لا تمار.
The clause «إنّي فاعل ...» is in the position of the accusative as the object of saying.
(إلّا) a particle of exception; (أن) a maṣdar-forming particle that makes accusative; (يشاء) an imperfect verb, accusative; (الله) the Majestic Name, agent, nominative.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يشاء الله..) is in the position of the accusative as the excepted (mustathnā), with a muḍāf omitted, i.e. "except at the time of Allah's will" «[Note: It is permissible that إلا be a particle of restriction, and the interpreted maṣdar after it be in the position of the genitive by an omitted preposition, namely الباء, attached to a ḥāl, i.e. "except accompanied by Allah's will".]».
24- (الواو) a conjunction; (اذكر) an imperative verb, and the agent is "you"; (ربّك) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and (الكاف) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (إذا) an adverb stripped of conditional meaning, attached to (اذكر); (نسيت) a past verb and its agent; (الواو) a conjunction; (قل) like اذكر; (عسى) a complete (tāmm) past verb; (أن يهدين) like أن يشاء.. and (النون) is for protection (wiqāya), and (الياء), omitted in the script, is the direct object; (ربّي) agent, nominative, and the sign of the nominative is the implied ḍamma on the letter before the yāʾ, and (الياء) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يهدين..) is in the position of the nominative as the agent of عسى.
(لأقرب) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يهدي), and the sign of the genitive is the fatḥa, because of being descriptive and on the pattern أفعل; (من) a preposition; (ها) for drawing attention; (ذا) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of the genitive, attached to (أقرب); (رشدا) tamyīz (specification), accusative «[Note: Or a mafʿūl muṭlaq standing in for the maṣdar, being its synonym, i.e. "guide me with right guidance (rushd)", i.e. guidance (hidāya).]».
The clause «يشاء الله ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle-relative (أن). The clause «اذكر ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause لا تقولنّ.. in the previous verse.
The clause «نسيت ...» is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «قل ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause اذكر.
The clause «عسى أن يهدين ...» is in the position of the accusative as the object of saying.
The clause «يهدين ربّي ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the particle-relative (أن).

* Morphology:
(رابعهم): a numeral on the pattern فاعل indicating order.
(خمسة): a word indicating number; a feminine noun because what it counts is masculine; its pattern is فعلة, with fatḥa then sukūn.
(سادسهم): a numeral on the pattern فاعل, so it indicates order.
(رجما): the maṣdar of the triliteral رجم; its origin is "to pelt with stones", then it was borrowed for speech that is not established and not based on facts; its verb is of the bāb of قتل; its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn.
(سبعة): a noun of number — feminine because what is counted is masculine — its pattern is فعلة, with fatḥa then sukūn.
(ثامنهم): a numeral on the pattern فاعل because it indicates order.
(تمار): it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) in accordance with the mood; its imperfect is تماري — with yāʾ — and the pattern of تمار is تفاع.
(مراء): an aurally transmitted (samāʿī) maṣdar of the quadriliteral verb مارى; its pattern is فعال with kasra on the fāʾ, and it contains iʿlāl by conversion — or substitution (ibdāl) — its origin is مراي — with yāʾ — and when the yāʾ came final after a quiescent alif, it was converted to hamza.
(تستفت): it contains iʿlāl by deletion due to the jussive; in the nominative it is تستفتي; the weak letter was deleted for the jussive; its pattern is تستفع.

* Rhetoric:
- The implicit metaphor (istiʿāra makniyya) in the saying of Allah the Exalted «رَجْماً بِالْغَيْبِ».
Mentioning a matter without certain knowledge and reassurance of the heart was likened to throwing a stone that is of no use in being thrown and does not hit its target; then it was borrowed for it, and الرجم was put in the place of conjecture, until it became a conventional literal meaning (ḥaqīqa ʿurfiyya) for it.

safi-cedvel:25-25.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (لبثوا) a past verb and its agent (fāʿil); (في كهفهم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (لبثوا).. and (هم) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (ثلاث) an adverb of time, accusative (manṣūb), attached to (لبثوا); (مائة) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr); (سنين) badal (substitute) of ثلاثمائة — or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) — accusative, and the sign of the accusative is the yāʾ, as it is assimilated to the sound masculine plural «[Note: It is not permissible for (سنين) to be a tamyīz (specification) of المائة, because its tamyīz is a singular in the genitive by annexation, and the nunation of (ثلاثمائة) prevents annexation.]», (الواو) a conjunction; (ازدادوا) a past verb and its agent; (تسعا) tamyīz, accusative «[Note: Al-ʿUkbarī made it a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and al-Jamal followed him, saying: زاد, when built on the pattern افتعل, becomes transitive to one object. But it is stated in Lisān al-ʿArab: "زاد الشيء means ازداد", i.e. it is intransitive and nothing else.]».
The clause «لبثوا ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «ازدادوا ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the resumptive clause.

* Morphology:
(ازدادوا): it contains substitution (ibdāl) of the tāʾ of the افتعال pattern by a dāl after the zāy, and it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by converting the yāʾ into an alif; its origin is ازديدوا..
(تسعا): a noun of number that came masculine because what it counts is feminine, namely السنة; its pattern is فعل, with kasra then sukūn.

* Benefits:
1- The masculine and feminine of numbers:
a- Numbers from three to nine: they are the reverse of the counted noun in masculine and feminine.
Whether they are single, as in the saying of Allah the Exalted «سَخَّرَها عَلَيْهِمْ سَبْعَ لَيالٍ وَثَمانِيَةَ أَيَّامٍ حُسُوماً», or compound, as in: خمسة عشر قلما and سبع عشرة محبرة, or conjoined, as in: ثلاثة وعشرين يوما and أربعا وعشرين ساعة. As for «واحد» and «اثنان», they agree with the counted noun in all three cases.
As for مائة and ألف, their form does not change for masculine and feminine, and likewise the words for the decades from twenty to ninety.
Ten (العشرة): it is the reverse of its counted noun when single, and agrees with its counted noun when compound.
2- The noun of number:
From the noun of number an adjective is formed on the pattern فاعل, agreeing with what it qualifies.
If the number is annexed (muḍāf) and we make it definite, the definite article «ال» enters the muḍāf ilayhi.
If it is compound, ال enters its first part, and if it is conjoined, ال enters both parts together.
3- The i'rab of numbers:
a- From one to ten, when single: it is declined with vowels, except «اثنان» and «اثنتان», which are assimilated to the dual and declined like it.
Likewise the numbers مائة and ألف are declined with vowels.
b- اثنان for the masculine, اثنتان for the feminine, and the decades from twenty to ninety: they are declined with letters.
c- The compound numbers from eleven to nineteen, and from الحادي عشر to التاسع عشر, are parsed as «two compounded parts, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa», excepted from the compound being «the first part of اثنا عشر», which is assimilated to the dual, as we mentioned. So take heed..!

safi-cedvel:26-26.t:
* I'rab:
(قل الله أعلم) like قل ربّي أعلم «[Note: In verse (22) of this sūra.]», (بما لبثوا) like بما لبثتم «[Note: In verse (19) of this sūra.]», (اللام) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) a fronted khabar (predicate); (غيب) a delayed mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ); (السموات) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr); (الأرض) conjoined (maʿṭūf) to السموات by the wāw, genitive.
The interpreted maṣdar (ما لبثوا) is in the position of the genitive by the bāʾ, attached to (أعلم).
(أبصر) a past verb for expressing wonder (taʿajjub), which came in the form of the imperative, indeclinable (mabnī) on the implied fatḥa because it comes in the form of the imperative; (الباء) a redundant (zāʾida) preposition, and (الهاء) a pronoun whose near position is the genitive by the bāʾ and whose remote position is the nominative as fāʿil (agent); (الواو) a conjunction; (أسمع) like أبصر, with به implied «[Note: It was said: أبصر به وأسمع are a real command, not wonder, and the hāʾ refers back to the guidance understood from the context.]», (ما) negative; (اللام) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to a fronted khabar; (من دونه) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of وليّ.. and (الهاء) is muḍāf ilayhi; (من) a redundant preposition; (وليّ) genitive in form, nominative in position, a delayed mubtadaʾ; (الواو) a conjunction; (لا) negative; (يشرك) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the agent is "he" (هو); (في حكمه) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يشرك), and (الهاء) is muḍāf ilayhi; (أحدا) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb).
The clause «قل ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «الله أعلم ...» is in the position of the accusative as the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «لبثوا ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle-relative (أما) «[Translator's note: the source prints (أما); the particle-relative here is evidently (ما).]».
The clause «له غيب السموات ...» has no grammatical position: causal (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «أبصر به ...» has no grammatical position: a resumption within the scope of the saying.
The clause «أسمع (به) ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause أبصر به.
The clause «ما لهم من دونه من وليّ ...» has no grammatical position: causal.
The clause «لا يشرك ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the last causal clause.

safi-cedvel:71-73.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) resumptive; (انطلقا) a past verb, and (الألف) a pronoun functioning as fāʿil (agent); (حتّى) for commencement (ibtidāʾ); (إذا) an adverb of future time containing the sense of a condition, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (خرقها); (ركبا) like انطلقا; (في السفينة) a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (ركبا); (خرقها) a past verb, and (ها) a pronoun functioning as mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the agent is "he", i.e. the learned man (al-Khaḍir); (قال) like خرق; (الهمزة) for the interrogative of astonishment; (خرقتها) a past verb with its agent and its object; (اللام) the lām of causation (taʿlīl); (تغرق) an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) "an" after the lām, and the agent is "you"; (أهلها) a direct object, accusative.. and (ها) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) (أن تغرق..) is in the position of genitive by the lām, attached to (خرقتها); (اللام) the lām of the oath, for an implied (muqaddar) oath; (قد) a particle of realization (taḥqīq); (جئت) like خرقت; (شيئا) a direct object, accusative; (إمرا) a naʿt (adjective) of (شيئا), accusative.
The clause «انطلقا ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive; the clause «ركبا ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; the clause «خرقها ...» has no grammatical position, the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition; the clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī); the clause «خرقتها ...» is in the position of accusative as the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl); the clause «تغرق ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the implied particle-relative (أن); the clause «جئت شيئا ...» has no grammatical position, the answer to an implied oath. 72- (قال) like خرق; (الهمزة) for the interrogative of disapproval (inkārī); (لم) a particle of negation and jussive; (أقل) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), and the agent is "I"; (إنّك) a particle resembling the verb, and the kāf is a pronoun, the noun of inna, in the position of accusative; (لن تستطيع معي صبرا) its i'rab has already passed [Note: Verse (67) of this sūra.].
The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption; the clause «لم أقل ...» is in the position of accusative as the speech reported by the verb قال; the clause «إنّك لن تستطيع ...» is in the position of accusative as the speech reported by the verb أقل; the clause «تستطيع ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of inna. 73- (قال) like خرق; (لا) a jussive particle of prohibition; (تؤاخذني) an imperfect verb, jussive, and (النون) is for protection (wiqāya), and (الياء) a pronoun functioning as direct object, and the agent is "you"; (الباء) a preposition; (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle [Note: Or a relative noun — or an indefinite noun qualified by an adjective — in the genitive by the bāʾ, with the referring pronoun omitted, i.e. "nasītuhu" (which I forgot); the clause is then a ṣila with no grammatical position, or an adjective of (ما) in the position of genitive.]
, (نسيت) a past verb.. and (التاء) the agent.
The interpreted maṣdar (ما نسيت) is in the position of genitive by the bāʾ, attached to (تؤاخذ); (الواو) conjunction; (لا ترهقني) like لا تؤاخذني; (من أمري) a preposition and its genitive noun attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the agent pronoun, i.e. "being straitened by my affair"; (عسرا) a second direct object, accusative, because ترهق is made to carry the meaning of تكلّف (to burden) [Note: In al-Mukhtār: rahiqahu: he covered him (ghashiyahu), and its pattern-class is that of ṭariba; and arhaqahu ʿusran: he burdened him with it. [Translator's note: the source prints «غضيه», apparently a misprint for «غشيه»; translated as "covered".].
The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption; the clause «لا تؤاخذني ...» is in the position of accusative as the speech reported; the clause «نسيت ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the particle-relative (ما); the clause «لا ترهقني ...» is in the position of accusative, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause لا تؤاخذني.

* Morphology:
(السفينة), a primitive (jāmid) noun for the means of transport at sea; its pattern is فعيلة; the plural is سفن on the pattern فعل with two ḍammas, and سفين and سفائن.
(إمرا), an assimilated adjective (ṣifa mushabbaha) from amira al-shayʾu, i.e. the matter became grave and abhorrent; its pattern is فعل with kasra then sukūn.

* Rhetoric:
- Double entendre (tawriya):
In the saying of Allah the Exalted «قالَ لا تُؤاخِذْنِي بِما نَسِيتُ».
He framed the speech as a prohibition of being taken to task for forgetting, giving the impression that he had forgotten, so as to extend his excuse for the objection. It is one of the indirect expressions (maʿārīḍ al-kalām) by which lying is avoided while the aim is still reached, like the saying of Ibrāhīm: "This is my sister", and "I am ill".

safi-cedvel:74-74.t:
* I'rab:
(فانطلقا حتّى إذا لقيا) the i'rab of its counterpart has already passed «1»
, (غلاما: a direct object, accusative; (الفاء) conjunction of immediate sequence (taʿqīb); (قتله) a past verb, and (الهاء) a pronoun functioning as mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil (agent) is "he", i.e. al-Khaḍir; (قال أقتلت نفسا) like قال أخرقتها «2»
, (زكيّة) a naʿt (adjective) of (نفسا), accusative; (بغير) a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the agent of قتلت, i.e. "being unjust", or of the object, i.e. "being wronged" [Note: It may be attached to the verb قتلت, i.e. "without cause ...", or to an omitted absolute object, i.e. "a killing without (taking) a soul".]
, (نفس) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive; (لقد جئت شيئا نكرا) like لقد جئت شيئا إمرا [Note: In verse (71) of this sūra.].
The clause «انطلقا ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive; the clause «لقيا ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; the clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position, the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition; the clause «أقتلت ...» is in the position of accusative as the direct object of the verb of saying; the clause «جئت شيئا ...» has no grammatical position, the answer to an implied oath.. and the clause of the implied oath is resumptive, within the scope of the saying.

* Morphology:
(زكيّة), feminine of زكيّ, an assimilated adjective (ṣifa mushabbaha) from زكا يزكو, of the pattern-class of qatala; its pattern is فعيل, and its second radical has been assimilated into its third; the third radical is converted from a wāw, its original form being زكيو: the yāʾ and the wāw met in one word with the first of them vowelless, so the wāw was changed into a yāʾ and assimilated into the yāʾ of فعيل; the feminine is فعيلة.
(نكرا), an assimilated adjective from نكر ينكر, of the pattern-class of karuma, i.e. it became grave and severe; its pattern is فعل with ḍamma then sukūn, and the word may come with two ḍammas with the same meaning.
Part Sixteen
The remainder of Sūrat al-Kahf

safi-cedvel:75-75.t:
* [Note: After Allah favoured me by making easy the i'rab of the first half of the Mighty Qur'an, I saw fit to restrict my i'rab in the second half to what the parser needs regarding nouns, verbs and particles of meaning, the i'rab of clauses, the attachment of prepositional phrases and adverbs, and mention of the different i'rab possibilities — if there are any — according to the reading of Ḥafṣ alone.
As for morphology, I shall deal with the words whose morphology was not treated in the first half, and I shall refer the honourable reader — rarely — to some words whose morphology was treated earlier. Allah is the Helper, the Granter of success.]

* I'rab:
(لك) attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أقل) [Note: See verse (72) of this Sūrat al-Kahf, in Part (15).].
The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «أقل ...» is in the position of accusative as the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl) by the verb (قال).
The clause «إنّك لن تستطيع ...» is in the position of accusative as the speech reported by the verb (أقل).

safi-cedvel:76-76.t:
* I'rab:
(سألتك) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); (عن شيء) attached to (mutaʿalliq) (سألتك); (بعد) attached to the verb سألتك; (الفاء) linking the apodosis; (لدنّي) a noun indeclinable on sukūn, in the position of genitive, attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of (عذرا)..
and the second (النون) is for protection (wiqāya); (عذرا) a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative.
The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «سألتك ...» is in the position of accusative as the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «لا تصاحبني ...» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «بلغت ...» has no grammatical position, a causal resumption (istiʾnāf taʿlīlī).

* Morphology:
(عذرا), an aurally-transmitted (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the triliteral عذر, of the pattern-class of ḍaraba; its pattern is فعل with ḍamma then sukūn.

safi-cedvel:77-77.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) resumptive; (حتّى) a particle of commencement (ibtidāʾ); (الفاء) conjunction; (أبوا) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the alif that was dropped because of the meeting of two vowelless letters; (يضيّفوهما) an imperfect verb, the sign of its accusative being the dropping of the nūn.
The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) (أن يضيّفوهما) is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object), its governor being أبوا.
(فيها) attached to (mutaʿalliq) (وجدا).
The interpreted maṣdar (أن ينقضّ..) is in the position of accusative as direct object, its governor being يريد.
(لو) a non-jussive conditional particle; (اللام) linking the apodosis of لو; (عليه) attached to an omitted second direct object of the verb اتّخذ; (أجرا) a first direct object, accusative.
The clause «انطلقا ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «أتيا ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
The clause «استطعما ...» has no grammatical position, the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition; according to Ibn Hishām it is an adjective of قرية and not the apodosis of the condition.. rather the clause قال لو شئت.. is the apodosis clause.. He said: because the repetition of the overt noun strips the clause of the meaning of an apodosis, and because it is analogous to the apodosis clause in the story of the boy, namely the saying of Allah the Exalted: قال أقتلت نفسا زكية..
The clause «أبوا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause استطعما.
The clause «يضيّفوهما ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle-relative (أن).
The clause «وجدا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause أبوا ...
The clause «ينقضّ ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the second particle-relative (أن).
The clause «يريد ...» is in the position of accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of (جدارا).
The clause «أقامه ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause وجدا..
The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «شئت ...» is in the position of accusative as the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «اتّخذت ...» has no grammatical position, the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.

* Morphology:
(أبوا), it contains a weak-letter change (iʿlāl) by deletion; its original form is أباوا: two vowelless letters met, so the third radical, the alif, was dropped, and the fatḥa remained on the bāʾ as an indication of what was dropped; its pattern is فعوا with fatḥa on the second radical.
(جدارا), a primitive (jāmid) noun for a wall or the barrier between two places; its pattern is فعال with kasra on the first radical.

* Benefits:
- Metaphor (istiʿāra):
In the saying of Allah the Exalted «فَوَجَدا فِيها جِداراً يُرِيدُ أَنْ يَنْقَضَّ فَأَقامَهُ».
What is meant by "wanting" to fall is its nearness to that, by way of a mursal trope (majāz mursal), through the relation that the wanting to fall is caused by its nearness; or by way of metaphor, in that the nearness of falling is likened to wanting because of the inclination it involves; and it is also permissible to consider the speech as containing an implicit (makniyya) and imaginative (takhyīliyya) metaphor.

safi-cedvel:27-29.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (اتل) an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the weak letter, and the fāʿil (agent) is "you" (أنت); (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (أوحي) a past verb, passive, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو", and it is the referent (ʿāʾid); (إلى) a preposition and (الكاف) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أوحي); (من كتاب) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the deputy agent; (ربّك) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr)..
and (الكاف) is muḍāf ilayhi; (لا) the lā of generic negation; (مبدّل) the noun of lā, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative; (لكلماته) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar (predicate) of lā.. and (الهاء) is muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) a conjunction; (لن) a particle of negation that makes accusative; (تجد) an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb), and the agent is "you"; (من دونه) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted second direct object, and (الهاء) is muḍāf ilayhi; (ملتحدا) first direct object, accusative.
The clause «اتل ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «أوحي ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (ما).
The clause «لا مبدّل لكلماته» is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl of كتاب.
The clause «لن تجد ...» is in the position of the accusative, conjoined to the clause لا مبدّل..
28- (الواو) a conjunction; (اصبر) like اتل; (نفسك) mafʿūl bihi, accusative..
and (الكاف) is muḍāf ilayhi; (مع) an adverb, accusative, attached to the verb اصبر; (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; (يدعون) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ).. and (الواو) is the agent; (ربّهم) mafʿūl bihi, accusative.. and (هم) is muḍāf ilayhi; (بالغداة) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يدعون); (العشيّ) conjoined (maʿṭūf) to الغداة by the wāw, genitive; (يريدون) like يدعون; (وجهه) mafʿūl bihi, accusative.. and (الهاء) is muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) a conjunction; (لا) prohibitive, making jussive; (تعد) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), and the sign of the jussive is the dropping of the weak letter; (عيناك) agent, nominative, and the sign of the nominative is the alif.. and (الكاف) is muḍāf ilayhi; (عن) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (تعد); (تريد) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the agent is "you"; (زينة) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (الحياة) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (الدنيا) naʿt (adjective) of الحياة, genitive, and the sign of the genitive is the implied kasra on the alif; (الواو) a conjunction; (لا تطع) like لا تعد, and the sign of the jussive is the sukūn; (من) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative as direct object; (أغفلنا) a past verb and its agent; (قلبه) mafʿūl bihi, accusative..
and (الهاء) is muḍāf ilayhi; (عن ذكرنا) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أغفلنا), and (نا) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) a conjunction; (اتّبع) a past verb, and the agent is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو"; (هواه) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and the sign of the accusative is the implied fatḥa on the alif..
and (الهاء) is muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) a conjunction; (كان) an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb; (أمره) the noun of kāna, nominative.. and (الهاء) is muḍāf ilayhi; (فرطا) the khabar of kāna, accusative.
The clause «اصبر ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause اتل.
The clause «يدعون ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative (الذين).
The clause «يريدون ...» is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl of the agent of يدعون.
The clause «لا تعد عيناك ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause اصبر.
The clause «تريد ...» is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl of the second-person pronoun in (عيناك) «[Note: The ḥāl may validly come from the muḍāf ilayhi because the muḍāf is part of the muḍāf ilayhi.]».
The clause «لا تطع ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause لا تعد.
The clause «أغفلنا ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative (من).
The clause «اتّبع هواه ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «كان أمره فرطا» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the ṣila clause.
29- (الواو) a conjunction; (قل) like اتل; (الحقّ) mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative «[Note: Or it is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "هذا القرآن", and the preposition and its genitive noun are a ḥāl of الحقّ, the governing factor in it being the demonstrative.]», (من ربّكم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar of the mubtadaʾ.. and (كم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الفاء) a conjunction «[Note: Or linking the apodosis of an implied condition.. or resumptive.]», (من) a conditional noun making jussive, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ; (شاء) a past verb «[Note: In the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ).]», and the agent is "he" (هو), and the object is omitted; (الفاء) linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (اللام) the lām of command; (يؤمن) an imperfect verb, jussive by the lām of command, and the agent is "he"; (الواو) a conjunction; (من شاء فليكفر) like its preceding counterpart; (إنّا) a particle resembling the verb.. and (نا) a pronoun in the position of the accusative as the noun of inna; (أعتدنا) like أغفلنا; (للظالمين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أعتدنا), and the sign of the genitive is the yāʾ; (نارا) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (أحاط) a past verb; (الباء) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (أحاط); (سرادقها) agent, nominative..
and (ها) is muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) a conjunction; (إن) a conditional particle making jussive; (يستغيثوا) an imperfect verb, jussive, the protasis, and the sign of the jussive is the dropping of the nūn.. and (الواو) is the agent; (يغاثوا) an imperfect verb, passive, jussive, the apodosis, and the sign of the jussive is the dropping of the nūn..
and (الواو) is the deputy agent; (بماء) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يغاثوا); (كالمهل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an adjective of (ماء); (يشوى) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the sign of the nominative is the implied ḍamma on the yāʾ, and the agent is "it" (هو); (الوجوه) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (بئس) a frozen (jāmid) past verb for expressing blame; (الشراب) agent, nominative, and the one specified for blame (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-dhamm) is omitted, its implied form being "هو", i.e. the water that is like molten metal; (الواو) a conjunction; (ساءت) a past verb for expressing blame..
and (التاء) is for the feminine. The agent is a pronoun that is necessarily latent, its implied form being "هي", i.e. the Fire; (مرتفقا) tamyīz (specification), accusative.
The clause «قل ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause اصبر.
The clause «الحقّ من ربّكم ...» is in the position of the accusative as the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «من شاء ...» is in the position of the accusative, conjoined to the clause of the object of saying «[Note: Or the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e. "if the truth has come to you, then whoever wills, let him believe".. It may also be resumptive.]».
The clause «شاء ...» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من).
The clause «يؤمن ...» is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «من شاء (the second)» is in the position of the accusative, conjoined to «على من شاء» (the first) «[Translator's note: the source has the preposition «على» doubled here ("معطوفة على «على من شاء»"); the intended meaning is "conjoined to «من شاء» (the first)".]».
The clause «شاء ...» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of the second mubtadaʾ (من).
The clause «يكفر ...» is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «إنّا أعتدنا ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī) — or a justification of what preceded. The clause «أعتدنا ...» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of inna.
The clause «أحاط بهم سرادقها» is in the position of the accusative as an adjective of (نارا).
The clause «إن يستغيثوا ...» is in the position of the accusative, conjoined to the clause أحاط, with the linking pronoun omitted, i.e. "if they seek relief in it" «[Note: It may be cut off as resumptive, so it would have no grammatical position.]».
The clause «يغاثوا ...» has no grammatical position: the apodosis of a jussive condition not joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «يشوي ...» is in the position of the genitive as a second adjective of ماء «[Note: It may be a ḥāl of المهل, in the position of the accusative.]».
The clause «بئس الشراب ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «ساءت مرتفقا» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause بئس الشراب.

* Morphology:
(ملتحدا): a noun of place from the five-letter verb التحد, meaning "to take refuge"; it is on the pattern of the passive participle, مفتعل, with ḍamma on the mīm and fatḥa on the ʿayn.
(فرطا): a maṣdar (verbal noun) meaning التفريط (neglect) or الإفراط (excess), i.e. a quasi-maṣdar (ism maṣdar) from أفرط في الأمر, i.e. he exceeded the limit.. or it is a derived adjective on the pattern فعل with two ḍammas, i.e. going ahead of the truth.
(سرادق): a noun for what surrounds a thing, like a tent or pavilion; it was said it is the chamber, and it was said it is what is stretched over the courtyard of a house. Al-Rāghib said: السرادق is Persian, Arabized, and there is no singular noun in their speech whose third letter is an alif followed by two letters except this one. And in al-Mukhtār:
السرادق is singular; its plural is سرادقات.. and every tent of كرسف, i.e. cotton, is a سرادق.
Its pattern is فعالل with ḍamma on the fāʾ.
(المهل): a noun that comprises the mineral substances, such as silver, iron and copper, and whatever of them is molten; it was said it is thin tar and thin oil.. Its pattern is فعل, with ḍamma on the fāʾ.
(مرتفقا): a passive participle from the five-letter ارتفق, meaning "to recline and lean"; its pattern is مفتعل with ḍamma on the mīm and fatḥa on the ʿayn.

* Rhetoric:
1- Antithesis (ṭibāq):
In the saying of Allah the Exalted «بِالْغَداةِ ... وَالْعَشِيِّ».
2- The explicit metaphor (istiʿāra taṣrīḥiyya):
In the saying of Allah the Exalted «إِنَّا أَعْتَدْنا لِلظَّالِمِينَ ناراً أَحاطَ بِهِمْ سُرادِقُها», where the Fire surrounding them with its flames, spreading from it in all directions, was likened to a pavilion pitched over those it contains; then it was borrowed for it as an explicit metaphor, the annexation being the contextual indicator (qarīna) and the surrounding being an enhancement (tarshīḥ).
3- The loose simile (tashbīh mursal):
In the saying of Allah the Exalted «بِماءٍ كَالْمُهْلِ يَشْوِي الْوُجُوهَ».
The water with which they are punished was likened to المهل, and المهل is what is melted of the substances of the earth. It is called loose and detailed (mursal mufaṣṣal), because the particle of comparison and the point of similarity are mentioned.
4- Sarcasm (tahakkum):
In the saying of Allah the Exalted «يُغاثُوا بِماءٍ كَالْمُهْلِ».
He called the highest kind of punishment "relief" (ighātha), while relief is rescue from punishment, in sarcasm toward them and in requital of them.
Sarcasm is a curious art among the arts of rhetoric, taken from تهكّمت البئر when a well collapses, or from التهكّم in the sense of intense anger, or regret over something missed. So the good tidings in it are a warning, the promise with it is a threat, and the honouring of the addressee mocked is contempt. This verse is among its finest examples, since He made the relief the very opposite of relief; so in addition to sarcasm it also contains mushākala (verbal correspondence).

* Benefits:
1- Making the word «الدنيا» definite and indefinite:
The rule is that we mention «الدنيا» definite with the alif and lām, because it is an adjective on the pattern «فعلى», so it should agree [with its noun], as it occurs in the verse mentioned. Nevertheless, they used it as nouns are used, so they hardly mention the qualified noun with it, and they frequently mentioned it stripped of the alif and lām like other nouns, as in the poet's saying:
وان دعوت إلى جلّى ومكرمة ... يوما سراة كرام الناس فادعينا
(If one day you call the chiefs of noble people to a grave matter and an honourable deed, then call us.)
So he brought جلّى without the definite article, and treated it like «دنيا». So take heed..!

safi-cedvel:30-31.t:
* I'rab:
(إنّ) a particle resembling the verb; (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the accusative as the noun of inna; (آمنوا) a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); (الواو) a conjunction; (عملوا) like آمنوا; (الصالحات) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), and the sign of the accusative is the kasra; (إنّا) like إنّ, and (نا) is the noun of inna; (لا) negative; (نضيع) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the agent is "we" (نحن) for majesty; (أجر) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (من) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (أحسن) a past verb, and the agent is "he" (هو), and it is the referent (ʿāʾid); (عملا) mafʿūl bihi, accusative.
The clause «إنّ الذين آمنوا ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «آمنوا ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين). The clause «عملوا ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause آمنوا.
The clause «إنّا لا نضيع ...» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the (first) inna, with the linking element implied, i.e. "we do not let their reward be lost" ... «[Note: It is permissible that the khabar be implied, i.e. "We will recompense them".. and the clause إنّا لا نضيع is a justification of the khabar.]».
The clause «لا نضيع ...» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of the (second) inna.
The clause «أحسن عملا» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative (من).
31- (أولئك) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject).. and (الكاف) is for address; (اللام) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) a fronted khabar; (جنّات) a delayed mubtadaʾ, nominative; (عدن) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr); (تجري) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the sign of the nominative is the implied ḍamma on the yāʾ; (من تحت) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تجري) «[Note: Or attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of الأنهار.]», and (هم) is an attached pronoun in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; (الأنهار) agent, nominative; (يحلّون) an imperfect verb, passive, nominative.. and (الواو) is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); (في) a preposition and (ها) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (يحلّون); (من أساور) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يحلّون) «[Note: Or it is an adjective of an omitted noun, i.e. "something of bracelets".]», and the sign of the genitive is the fatḥa, being a diptote as it is on the pattern of the ultimate plural (ṣīghat muntahā al-jumūʿ); (من ذهب) a preposition and its genitive noun, an adjective of أساور; (الواو) a conjunction; (يلبسون) an imperfect verb, nominative..
and (الواو) is the agent; (ثيابا) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (خضرا) naʿt (adjective) of (ثيابا), accusative; (من سندس) a preposition and its genitive noun, a second adjective of (ثيابا); (الواو) a conjunction; (إستبرق) conjoined (maʿṭūf) to سندس, genitive; (متّكئين) a ḥāl of the agent of يلبسون, accusative, and the sign of the accusative is the yāʾ; (فيها) like the first, attached to a ḥāl of the pronoun in متّكئين; (على الأرائك) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (متّكئين); (نعم) a past verb for expressing praise; (الثواب) agent, nominative, and the one specified for praise is omitted, its implied form being "هي", i.e. Paradise; (الواو) a conjunction; (حسنت مرتفقا) like ساءت مرتفقا «[Note: In verse (29) of this sūra.]».
The clause «أولئك لهم جنّات ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī) «[Note: It is permissible that the clause be the khabar of the first (إنّ), and what lies between them a parenthesis.]».
The clause «لهم جنات ...» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (أولئك).
The clause «تجري ... الأنهار» is in the position of the nominative as a second khabar of the mubtadaʾ (أولئك).
The clause «يحلّون ...» is in the position of the nominative as a third khabar of the mubtadaʾ (أولئك) «[Note: It may be in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl of the pronoun in (لهم), its governing factor being the [implied] "being settled" (al-istiqrār).]».
The clause «يلبسون ...» is in the position of the nominative, conjoined to the clause يحلّون.
The clause «نعم الثواب ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «حسنت مرتفقا» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the resumptive clause.

* Morphology:
(يحلّون): it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion; its origin is يحلّاون; two quiescent letters met, so the alif of the verb was deleted, and the letter before the wāw was given fatḥa to indicate it; its pattern is يفعّون.
(أساور): the plural of أسورة, which is the plural of سوار, a primitive (jāmid) noun for the well-known ornament, its pattern being فعال with kasra on the fāʾ; the pattern of أسورة is أفعلة — one of the plurals of paucity — and the pattern of أساور is أفاعل.
(سندس): the plural of سندسة; it was said it is not a plural but a noun for a kind of brocade or silk fabric; its pattern is فعلل with ḍamma on the fāʾ and the first lām.
(إستبرق): a noun for thick brocade; it was said to be Arabic in origin, derived from البريق, so its pattern is استفعل; and it was said to be Arabized from a foreign word whose origin is استبره.
(متّكئين): the plural of متّكئ, an active participle from the five-letter اتّكأ; the first (التاء) is substituted for a wāw; its origin is موتكئ, and when the wāw came before the tāʾ of the افتعال pattern it was converted into tāʾ and assimilated with the tāʾ of افتعال; its pattern is مفتعل with ḍamma on the mīm and kasra on the ʿayn.
(الأرائك): the plural of أريكة, a primitive noun for a couch that is in a room, or anything on which one reclines; its pattern is فعيلة.

* Benefits:
- In these verses there have occurred types of the art of rhetoric that call us to draw attention to them, even by mentioning some of them. He, Glory be to Him, intended «sarcasm» (tahakkum) toward the people of the Fire, so He mentioned that when they seek relief they are relieved with water like molten metal; so what do you think of this kind of relief? Likewise mushākala (verbal correspondence), in the saying of Allah the Exalted وَساءَتْ مُرْتَفَقاً, which corresponds to the saying of Allah the Exalted: وَحَسُنَتْ مُرْتَفَقاً, knowing that reclining at ease (al-irtifāq) does not occur in matters of misery and wretchedness, but only in the domain of happiness and comfort. We have alluded to these two aspects of the rhetoric of the Revelation because of the splendour of expression and the literary arts in these verses.

safi-cedvel:78-78.t:
* I'rab:
(هذا) mubtadaʾ (subject), its khabar (predicate) being (فراق); (بيني) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive [Note: (بين) here is a noun meaning "union", i.e. the parting of our union.. and بين has been annexed to what is not plural/multiple because of the repetition through conjunction.]
, the sign of the genitive being the kasra implied (muqaddar) on the letter before the yāʾ; and (بين) is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the first, genitive like it; (بتأويل) attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أنبّئك); (ما) a relative noun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; (عليه) attached to (صبرا).
The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «هذا فراق ...» is in the position of accusative as the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «سأنبّئك ...» has no grammatical position, a resumption within the scope of the saying.
The clause «تستطع ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (ما).

* Morphology:
(فراق), an aurally-transmitted (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the quadriliteral verb فارق; its pattern is فعال with kasra on the first radical.
(بيني- بينك), a noun meaning "union", and it also comes in the meaning of "separation", so it is one of the words with opposite meanings (aḍdād); its pattern is فعل with fatḥa then sukūn.

* Benefits:
1- Verbs that take three objects in the accusative:
They are: أعلم، أرى، أنبأ، نبّأ، أخبر، خبّر and حدّث.
The basic ones among these verbs are «أعلم and أرى»; originally they are among the verbs that take two objects before the hamza of transitivity was added to them, for originally they are «علم and رأى». «خبّر» is attached to them, for it too is for informing. As for the rest, they have no triliteral form conveying knowledge.
These five are used as transitive to a single object without an intermediary, e.g. «حدثت عليا» (I spoke to ʿAlī), and to more than one by means of the bāʾ, e.g. «حدثتك بخبر أخيك» (I told you the news of your brother). Of this is the saying of Allah the Exalted: «سَأُنَبِّئُكَ بِتَأْوِيلِ ما لَمْ تَسْتَطِعْ عَلَيْهِ صَبْراً».
This discussion has a continuation that will come in its proper places, Allah willing.
2- Stories in the Qur'an:
We alluded earlier to some characteristics of the story in the Qur'an, and because of the importance of this subject we return to remind of it and to clarify some of its aspects, especially as we are before a story that is one of the masterpieces of Quranic narrative, with many benefits. So observe with me this dialogue that took place between Mūsā and al-Khaḍir, whose basis is informing on the one hand and the use of hamzas of disapproval on the other; then concision and restriction to what is indispensable for constructing the frame of the story; and last but not least, the use of the detailing «أمّا» to explain the obscurities of the story, which awaits the brush of the gifted artist to extract its pearls from their shells and present them on a silver platter to the pioneers of art and to those who find in the art of the story an enjoyment they do not find in other arts.

safi-cedvel:79-82.t:
* I'rab:
(أمّا) a particle of condition and detailing (tafṣīl); (الفاء) linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (لمساكين) a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of كانت, the sign of the genitive being the fatḥa, for it is a diptote; (في البحر) attached to (يعملون); (الفاء) conjunction.
The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) (أن أعيبها) is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object), its governor being أردت.
(وراءهم) an adverb, accusative, attached to an omitted khabar of كان; (ملك) the noun (ism) of the incomplete (nāqiṣ) كان; (غصبا) a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar, so it specifies its kind [Note: Or a maṣdar in the place of a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "usurping it".. or it is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), accusative.].
The clause «السفينة فكانت ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «كانت لمساكين ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (subject) [Note: The underlying expression is: "Whatever may be the case, the ship was.." When أمّا took the place of the condition and its verb, the fāʾ moved to the predicate.].
The clause «يعملون ...» is in the position of genitive as a naʿt (adjective) of مساكين.
The clause «أردت ...» is in the position of nominative, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause كانت..
The clause «أعيبها ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle-relative (أن).
The clause «كان وراءهم ملك» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl, with (قد) understood [Note: It may be parenthetical, having the force of a causal statement.].
The clause «يأخذ ...» is in the position of nominative as an adjective of ملك.
80- (الواو) conjunction; (أبواه) the noun of كان, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the alif.. and (الهاء) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (مؤمنين) the khabar of كان, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ; (الفاء) conjunction; (طغيانا) a maṣdar in the place of an anticipated (muqaddara) ḥāl [Note: Or a mafʿūl li-ajlihi, accusative.].
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يرهقهما) is in the position of accusative as direct object, its governor being خشينا.
The clause «الغلام فكان ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to السفينة كانت..
The clause «كان أبواه مؤمنين ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الغلام).
The clause «خشينا ...» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause كان أبواه..
The clause «يرهقهما ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the particle-relative (أن).
81- (الفاء) conjunction; (خيرا) a second direct object, accusative, its governor being يبدلهما; (منه) attached to (خيرا); (زكاة) a tamyīz (specification), accusative, for (خيرا); (رحما) a tamyīz, accusative, for (أقرب), which is conjoined to (خيرا) and accusative like it; it is denied nunation because it is an adjective on the pattern أفعل, and (منه) is understood because it was mentioned before.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يبدلهما..) is in the position of accusative as direct object, its governor being أردنا..
The clause «أردنا ...» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause خشينا.
The clause «يبدلهما ربّهما ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the particle-relative (أن).
82- (الواو) conjunction; (لغلامين) attached to the khabar of كان, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ; (في المدينة) attached to a second adjective of (غلامين); (الواو) conjunction; (تحته) an adverb, accusative, attached to the khabar of كان; (كنز) the noun of كان, postponed, nominative; (لهما) attached to an adjective of (كنز).
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يبلغا..) is in the position of accusative as direct object, its governor being أراد.
(يستخرجا) an imperfect verb, accusative, conjoined to (يبلغا) by the wāw, the sign of the accusative being the dropping of the nūn like the first, and (الألف) is the fāʿil (agent) in both; (رحمة) a mafʿūl li-ajlihi, accusative, its governor being أراد [Note: Or a maṣdar in the place of a ḥāl.]
, (من ربّك) attached to an adjective of (رحمة); (الواو) conjunction; (ما) negating; (عن أمري) a preposition and its genitive noun, a ḥāl of the agent, i.e. "independently" or "on my own"; (ذلك) mubtadaʾ, its khabar being (تأويل); (ما) a relative in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; (عليه) attached to (صبرا). The clause «الجدار فكان ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause الغلام فكان..
The clause «كان لغلامين ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الجدار).
The clause «كان تحته كنز ...» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause كان لغلامين.
The clause «كان أبوهما صالحا ...» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause كان لغلامين.
The clause «أراد ربّك ...» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause كان لغلامين [Note: The clause may be resumptive after the fāʾ.].
The clause «يبلغا ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the particle-relative (أن).
The clause «يستخرجا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause يبلغا..
The clause «ما فعلته ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause أمّا الجدار ...
The clause «ذلك تأويل ...» has no grammatical position, a resumption within the scope of the saying.
The clause «لم تسطع ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative (ما).

* Morphology:
(غصبا), an aurally-transmitted (samāʿī) maṣdar of the verb غصب يغصب, of the pattern-class of ḍaraba; its pattern is فعل with fatḥa then sukūn.
(زكاة), a noun from زكا يزكو الرجل, i.e. he became righteous, so it means righteousness; its pattern is فعله with two fatḥas [Translator's note: so in the source; the intended pattern is presumably فعلة.], and it contains a weak-letter change (iʿlāl) by conversion: its original form is زكوة; the wāw came voweled after a fatḥa, so it was converted into an alif.
(رحما), a maṣdar of رحم يرحم, of the pattern-class of fariḥa, meaning he was dutiful to him and tender toward him; its pattern is فعل with ḍamma then sukūn; there are other maṣdars: رحمة، مرحمة and رحم with two ḍammas.
(تسطع), it involves dropping the tāʾ of the iftiʿāl form; استطاع and اسطاع are two dialectal forms, where the tāʾ is dropped from the past and the imperfect [Note: In verse (97) of this sūra the past tense will occur without the tāʾ: «فما اسطاعوا أن يظهروه ...».].

* Rhetoric:
1- Fronting and postponement (al-taqdīm wa-l-taʾkhīr):
In the saying of Allah the Exalted «فَأَرَدْتُ أَنْ أَعِيبَها».
His saying «فَأَرَدْتُ أَنْ أَعِيبَها» is caused by the fear of its being seized by force, so it ought to have come after the cause; it was only brought forward because it is the goal, and because the fear of seizure is not the sole cause, but rather together with its belonging to the poor.
2- Teaching good manners:
In the saying of Allah the Exalted «فَأَرَدْتُ أَنْ أَعِيبَها».
Whereas Allah said in a later verse: «فَأَرادَ رَبُّكَ».
He ascribed to himself what outwardly is evil, and ascribed the good to Allah the Exalted; that is to teach good manners with Allah, Majestic and Exalted is He.

safi-cedvel:83-85.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (عن ذي) attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يسألونك), the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ; (عليكم) attached to (أتلو); (منه) attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of (ذكرا), the object of أتلو.
The clause «يسألونك ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «قل ...» has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «سأتلو ...» is in the position of accusative as the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl).
84- (إنّا) a particle resembling the verb.. and (نا) its noun; the object of (مكّنّا) is omitted, its implied form being "the matter"; (له) attached to (مكّنّا), and likewise (في الأرض); (من كلّ) attached to (آتينا) [Note: Or to an omitted ḥāl of (سببا).]
, (سببا) a second mafʿūl bihi (direct object), its governor being آتينا.
The clause «إنّا مكّنّا ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «مكّنّا ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of inna.
The clause «آتيناه ...» is in the position of nominative, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause مكّنّا..
85- (الفاء) conjunction; (سببا) a direct object, accusative [Note: It is said that the second object is omitted, i.e. "he followed one means with another means"; and it is said that it is transitive to one object.].
The clause «أتبع ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause إنّا مكّنّا.

* Morphology:
(القرنين) dual of قرن, a primitive (jāmid) noun for what appears on the head of cloven-hoofed animals (horn); its pattern is فعل with fatḥa then sukūn; its plural is قرون with ḍamma on the qāf.
(سببا), a primitive noun meaning "rope", then borrowed for everything by which one reaches something; its pattern is فعل with two fatḥas.

safi-cedvel:86-86.t:
* I'rab:
(حتّى) a particle of commencement (ibtidāʾ); (في عين) attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تغرب) [Note: The seeing is according to appearance, not according to reality.]
, (الواو) conjunction; (عندها) an adverb, accusative, attached to (وجد) [Note: Or attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of (قوما).]
. (ذا) the one addressed (munādā), a muḍāf, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the alif; (إمّا) a particle of choice (takhyīr) [Note: Or it is a particle of division (taqsīm).]
, (فيهم) attached to an omitted second mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of (تتّخذ), and the first object is (حسنا).
The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) (أن تعذّب) is in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), and the khabar (predicate) is omitted, i.e. "either your punishing befalls them" [Note: It may be the predicate of an omitted subject, its implied form being: "The recompense is your punishing them".]
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تتّخذ) is in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ, and the khabar is omitted, i.e. "your adopting goodness toward them befalls them" [Note: The conjunction is then a conjunction of clauses; or the second maṣdar may be conjoined to the first maṣdar, with either the predicate or the subject understood for both maṣdars together.].
The clause «بلغ ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
The clause «وجدها ...» has no grammatical position, the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «تغرب ...» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of the object.
The clause «وجد (the second)» has no grammatical position, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause وجد (the first).
The clause «قلنا ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «(the vocative) يا ذا القرنين» is in the position of accusative as the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «تعذيبك (واقع..)» has no grammatical position, the answer to the vocative.
The clause «اتّخاذك.. (واقع)» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the answer to the vocative.

* Morphology:
(حمئة), feminine of حمىء; its pattern is فعلة with fatḥa then kasra; an assimilated adjective (ṣifa mushabbaha) from حمىء يحمأ, of the pattern-class of fariḥa, when it is mixed with ḥamaʾ, which is black mud.

* Benefits:
- Optical illusion.
Often the address directed to people in the Noble Qur'an takes account of their senses in perception, and the speech is a kind of figurative usage (majāz) when we compare it with reality and fact. Of this is the saying of Allah the Exalted: «وَجَدَها تَغْرُبُ فِي عَيْنٍ حَمِئَةٍ», and in one reading «حامية» (hot). The reality is that the sun does not set in the middle of the «muddy» spring; rather this is what the seeing eye perceives. Illusions of the senses are many, so much so that books have been written about them and the tongues of poets have spoken of them. Al-Maʿarrī says:
والنجم تستصغر الأبصار رؤيته ... والذنب للطرف لا للنجم في الصغر
(The eyes deem the star small when they see it — yet the fault of smallness lies with the eye, not with the star.)
The considerations and established findings of science determine that the sun sets behind the terrestrial globe because of its rotation, not inside it as the senses imagine. Far be it from Allah to say what is not true; it is only figurative usage and taking account of the extent of people's perception. So reflect — may Allah guide us and you.

safi-cedvel:1-5.t:
* I'rab:
(الحمد) mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ); (لله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ; [Translator's note: the source gives no separate entry for (الذي) here, though it refers to it below as the relative.] (أنزل) a past verb; the fāʿil (agent) is «هو»; (على عبده) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أنزل), and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (الكتاب) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (الواو) a conjunction; (لم) a particle of negation and of the jussive; (يجعل) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm); the fāʿil is «هو»; (اللام) a preposition, and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted second mafʿūl bihi; (عوجا) first mafʿūl bihi, accusative.
The clause «الحمد لله ...» has no grammatical position: initial (ibtidāʾiyya).
The clause «أنزل ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الّذي).
The clause «لم يجعل ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the ṣila clause [Note: the clause may be a ḥāl (circumstantial) of الكتاب after the wāw of ḥāl... or parenthetical between the ḥāl — قيّما — and the one it describes.].
2- (قيّما) mafʿūl bihi of an omitted verb, its implied form being «جعله» [Note: or a ḥāl, the governing element being the implied verb... or an emphasizing ḥāl of the pronoun in (له), the governing element being لم يجعل... or a ḥāl of الكتاب, the clause لم يجعل being parenthetical or a ḥāl.], accusative; (اللام) causal (taʿlīl); (ينذر) an imperfect verb, accusative by an «أن» concealed after the lām; the fāʿil is «هو», and the first object is omitted, its implied form being «الكافرين»; (بأسا) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (شديدا) a naʿt (adjective) of (بأسا), accusative; (من) a preposition; (لدن) a noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of genitive, attached to a second naʿt of (بأسا) [Note: or attached to (ينذر); it may also be a ḥāl of the pronoun in (شديدا).], and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن ينذر) is in the position of genitive by the lām, attached to (أنزل).
(الواو) a conjunction; (يبشّر) like ينذر, conjoined to it; (المؤمنين) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ; (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as a naʿt of المؤمنين; (يعملون) an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the retention of the nūn... and (الواو) is the fāʿil; (الصالحات) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the kasra; (إنّ) [Translator's note: so printed; the verse has «أنّ», and the source itself goes on to speak of أنّ.] a particle of emphasis and of the accusative; (لهم) like له, attached to the khabar of أنّ; (أجرا) the noun of أنّ, accusative; (حسنا) a naʿt of (أجرا), accusative.
The interpreted maṣdar (أنّ لهم أجرا..) is in the position of genitive by an omitted bāʾ, attached to (يبشّر) [Note: i.e. "He gives them good news that they will have a reward"... The interpreted maṣdar may also be in the position of accusative as a second mafʿūl bihi of the verb يبشّر, by making it carry the sense of «يبلّغ» ("to convey").].
The clause «ينذر ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the concealed particle-relative (al-mawṣūl al-ḥarfī) (أن).
The clause «يبشّر ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause ينذر.
The clause «يعملون ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative (الذين).
3- 4- (ماكثين) a ḥāl, accusative, of the pronoun in (لهم), the governing element in it being the notion of "being established" (al-istiqrār); (في) a preposition, and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (ماكثين); (أبدا) an adverb of time, accusative, attached to (ماكثين). (الواو) a conjunction; (ينذر) like the first and conjoined to it; (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi; (قالوا) a past verb, indeclinable on ḍamma... and (الواو) is the fāʿil; (اتّخذ) a past verb; (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative; (ولدا) second mafʿūl bihi, the first being omitted, its implied form being "عيسى" or "عزير" (ʿĪsā or ʿUzayr)...
The clause «ينذر ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause ينذر (the first).
The clause «قالوا ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative (الذين).
The clause «اتّخذ الله ...» is in the position of accusative as the speech reported by the verb of saying (maqūl al-qawl).
5- (ما) negative; (لهم) like له, attached to a khabar placed first; (به) like فيه, attached to a ḥāl of علم; (من) a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; (علم) genitive in form, nominative in position, a mubtadaʾ placed after; (الواو) a conjunction; (لا) redundant, to reinforce the negation; (لآبائهم) conjoined to the preposition phrase لهم and attached to what it is attached to... and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (كبرت) a past verb used to express blame (inshāʾ al-dhamm), and (التاء) marks the feminine; the fāʿil is a pronoun necessarily latent (mustatir), its implied form being «هي»; (كلمة) a tamyīz (specification) of the agent pronoun, accusative [Note: the one specified for blame (al-makhṣūṣ bil-dhamm) is omitted, its implied form being "their aforementioned saying".]; (تخرج) an imperfect verb, nominative; the fāʿil is «هي»; (من أفواههم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تخرج); (إن) a particle of negation; (يقولون) like يعملون; (إلّا) a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); (كذبا) mafʿūl bihi, accusative [Note: or a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar, being its qualifier, i.e. "a false saying".].
The clause «ما لهم به من علم ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «كبرت ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «تخرج ...» is in the position of accusative as a naʿt of كلمة.
The clause «يقولون ...» has no grammatical position: causal (taʿlīliyya).

* Morphology:
(ماكثين): plural of ماكث, an active participle of the triliteral مكث; its wazn is فاعل.

* Rhetoric:
1- Repetition (al-takrīr) in the words of the Exalted: «وَلَمْ يَجْعَلْ لَهُ عِوَجاً قَيِّماً».
Negating crookedness of it means affirming straightness for it; it inclines to repetition for a benefit, namely emphasis, for many a straight thing attested as straight is not free of the slightest crookedness upon probing and close examination.
2- Antithesis (al-muṭābaqa): He, Glorified and Exalted be His majesty, set crookedness and straightness against each other, and it was splendid, leaving no room for a critic.
3- Negating a thing by affirming it:
In the words of the Exalted: «قالُوا اتَّخَذَ اللَّهُ وَلَداً ما لَهُمْ بِهِ مِنْ عِلْمٍ». This art has another name: reversal of the apparent (ʿaks al-ẓāhir).
It is that you say something whose apparent meaning indicates that it negates an attribute of something described, while it is in fact a negation of the described thing altogether. Allah's taking a son is in itself impossible, so how was it said «ما لَهُمْ بِهِ مِنْ عِلْمٍ»?
Its meaning is: they have no knowledge of it, because it is not something that can be known, owing to its impossibility. The absence of knowledge of a thing is either due to ignorance of the path that leads to it, or because it is in itself impossible, so that knowledge cannot properly attach to it. Thus the speech came by way of mockery and ridicule of them.

* Benefits:
The mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose) has five conditions:
a- That it be a maṣdar (verbal noun).
b- That its verb be one of the acts of the soul, i.e. a maṣdar of the heart, such as veneration, respect, reverence, fear, desire, dread, shyness, compassion, knowledge and the like.
c- That it be a cause, i.e. what prompts the action.
d- That it coincide in time with what it gives the reason for.
e- That it share the same agent as what it gives the reason for.
So «جئتك محبة إياي» ("I came to you out of your love for me") is not valid.
Whenever one of its five conditions is missing, it must be put in the genitive by a causal preposition, «such as اللام, من, الباء and في», as in:
- «وَالْأَرْضَ وَضَعَها لِلْأَنامِ».
- «وَلا تَقْتُلُوا أَوْلادَكُمْ مِنْ إِمْلاقٍ».
فجئت وقد نضّت لنوم ثيابها ... لدى الستر إلا لبسة المتفضل
(I came when she had shed her clothes for sleep by the curtain, except the garment of one in a single robe.)

واني لتعروني لذكراك هزة ... كما انتفض العصفور بلله القطر
(A tremor seizes me at the memory of you, as the sparrow shudders when the raindrops have wetted it.)

safi-cedvel:6-8.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) resumptive; (لعلّك) a particle of hope (tarajjī) and of the accusative... and (الكاف) a pronoun in the position of accusative as the noun of لعلّ; (باخع) the khabar (predicate) of لعلّ, nominative (marfūʿ); (نفسك) mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the active participle باخع, accusative (manṣūb)... and (الكاف) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (على آثارهم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (باخع), and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (إن) a jussive conditional particle; (لم) a particle of negation; (يؤمنوا) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn... and (الواو) is the fāʿil (agent); (الباء) a preposition; (ها) a particle of alerting (tanbīh); (ذا) a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of genitive, attached to (يؤمنوا); (الحديث) a badal (substitute) of the demonstrative — or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) —, genitive; (أسفا) mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), accusative [Note: or a maṣdar in the place of a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun in باخع.].
The clause «لعلّك باخع ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «لم يؤمنوا ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī)... and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by His words «لعلّك باخع..».
7- (إنّا) a particle resembling the verb... and (نا) a pronoun in the position of accusative as the noun of إنّ; (جعلنا) a past verb and its fāʿil; (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi; (على الأرض) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted ṣila of ما; (زينة) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative [Note: or a ḥāl, if the verb is transitive to one object, meaning «خلقنا» ("We created").]; (اللام) a preposition, and (ها) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to a naʿt (adjective) of (زينة); (اللام) causal (taʿlīl); (نبلوهم) an imperfect verb, accusative by an «أن» concealed after the lām... and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; the fāʿil is «نحن», used for majesty; (أيّهم) an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative [Note: it may be a relative, indeclinable on ḍamma, in the position of accusative as a badal of the pronoun in (نبلوهم).], and (هم) muḍāf ilayhi; (أحسن) the khabar of the mubtadaʾ [Note: or the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being «هو» — أيّ being a relative noun — and the clause has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative.], nominative; (عملا) tamyīz (specification), accusative. The clause «إنّا جعلنا ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption — or causal (taʿlīliyya) —. The clause «جعلنا ما ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of إنّ.
The clause «نبلوهم ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the concealed particle-relative (al-mawṣūl al-ḥarfī) (أن).
The interpreted maṣdar (أن نبلوهم) is in the position of genitive by the lām, attached to (جعلنا).
The clause «أيّهم أحسن ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption — or an explanation of the trial. 8- (الواو) a conjunction; (إنّا) like the first; (اللام) the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), for emphasis; (جاعلون) the khabar of إنّ, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the wāw; (ما) like the first; (على) a preposition, and (ها) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to the omitted ṣila of ما; (صعيدا) second mafʿūl bihi of the active participle جاعلون, accusative; (جرزا) a naʿt of (صعيدا), accusative.
The clause «إنّا لجاعلون ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause «إنّا جعلنا».

* Morphology:
(باخع): an active participle of the triliteral (بخع); its wazn is فاعل.
(جرزا): a non-derived (jāmid) noun meaning "land whose vegetation has been cut off"; the word is then used here as a description by way of figurative usage (majāz). One says «أرض جرز» with two ḍammas, and «أرضون أجراز».

* Rhetoric:
- The representational metaphor (al-istiʿāra al-tamthīliyya):
In the words of the Exalted «فَلَعَلَّكَ باخِعٌ نَفْسَكَ عَلى آثارِهِمْ إِنْ لَمْ يُؤْمِنُوا بِهذَا الْحَدِيثِ أَسَفاً»: He has likened his state — may Allah bless him and his family and grant them peace — in the intensity of his grief at the people's turning away and their refusal to believe in the Qur'an, and his utter sorrow over them, to the state of one who is expected to destroy himself after losing what he loves upon parting from his loved ones, out of sorrow at parting from them and longing at their departure.

safi-cedvel:87-89.t:
* I'rab:
(أمّا) a particle of condition and detailing (tafṣīl); (من) a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); (الفاء) linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of أمّا [Note: The underlying construction of (أمّا من ظلم..) is: "Whatever the matter may be, then whoever does wrong, we shall punish him.." When (أمّا) took the place of the condition and came directly before the subject (من), the linking fāʾ was moved to the predicate; and such is the case of the predicate occurring after أمّا: the linking fāʾ attaches to it.]
, (سوف) a particle of the future; the fāʿil (agent) of (نعذّب) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "نحن" (we), for majesty; (يردّ) an imperfect verb, passive, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو" (he); (إلى ربّه) attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يردّ); (الفاء) conjunction; (عذابا) a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative; (نكرا) a naʿt (adjective) of (عذابا).
The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «من ظلم ...» is in the position of accusative as the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «ظلم ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (من).
The clause «سوف نعذّبه ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (من) [Note: The underlying construction of (أمّا من ظلم..) is: "Whatever the matter may be, then whoever does wrong, we shall punish him.." When (أمّا) took the place of the condition and came directly before the subject (من), the linking fāʾ was moved to the predicate; and such is the case of the predicate occurring after أمّا: the linking fāʾ attaches to it.].
The clause «يردّ ...» is in the position of nominative, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause نعذّبه.
The clause «يعذّبه ...» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause يردّ.
88- (الواو) conjunction, and (الفاء) linking the apodosis; (له) attached to a fronted khabar; (جزاء) a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the place of a ḥāl (circumstantial) of الحسنى, accusative [Note: Or a mafʿūl muṭlaq of an omitted verb, i.e. "he is recompensed with it a recompense".. and al-Farrāʾ said it is a tamyīz (specification) clarifying the relation of the predicate to the subject.], i.e. "being recompensed with it"; (الحسنى) a postponed mubtadaʾ, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif; (له) attached to (نقول); (من أمرنا) attached to (نقول), and (من) is for the beginning of the extent; (يسرا) a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative [Note: Or it is an absolute object standing in for the maṣdar, being its kind or its description; and the maṣdar may come as a description.].
The clause «من آمن ...» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause من ظلم..
The clause «آمن ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative (من).
The clause «عمل ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause آمن.
The clause «له.. الحسنى» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من).
The clause «سنقول ...» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause له الحسنى.
89- (سببا) a direct object, accusative [Note: See verse (85) of the sūra.].
The clause «أتبع ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the first clause أتبع [Note: (ثمّ) may be made a particle of resumption, so the clause is resumptive.].

safi-cedvel:90-90.t:
* I'rab:
(حتّى إذا.. تطلع) the i'rab of its counterpart has already passed [Note: In verse (86) of this sūra.], (على قوم) attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تطلع); (لهم) attached to the second object of the verb نجعل; (من دونها) a preposition and its genitive noun attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of (سترا), which is a first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative.
The clause «بلغ ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
The clause «وجدها ...» has no grammatical position, the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «تطلع ...» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl.
The clause «نجعل ...» is in the position of genitive as a naʿt (adjective) of قوم.

* Morphology:
(مطلع), a noun of place from طلع يطلع, of the pattern-class of naṣara; its pattern is مفعل with fatḥa on the mīm and kasra on the second radical, contrary to the analogical rule.
(سترا), a noun for that by which one covers, from the verb ستر يستر, of the pattern-class of naṣaʿa [Translator's note: so in the source, apparently a misprint for naṣara.] and of ḍaraba; its pattern is فعل with kasra then sukūn; its plural is ستور and أستار.

* Benefits:
- The noun of time and place:
We spoke earlier, sufficiently, about the nouns of time and place. For completeness we affirm that, from verbs of more than three letters, they are formed on the pattern of the imperfect after replacing the imperfect prefix with a mīm with ḍamma and giving fatḥa to the letter before the last, e.g. مجتمع، منتظر and مستشفى.
