They coincide in pattern with the passive participle and the mīm-maṣdar; distinguishing them comes down to taste and the available contextual indications.

safi-cedvel:91-92.t:
* I'rab:
(كذلك) a preposition and its genitive noun, the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "the matter" [Note: Or attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being "he judged", i.e. he judged concerning these who are at the rising place of the sun as he judged concerning those who are at its setting place.], (الواو) resumptive; (بمّا) attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb (أحطنا), and ما is relative; (لديه) an indeclinable adverb in the position of accusative, attached to the omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ما; (خبرا) a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), its governor being أحطنا.
The clause «(الأمر) كذلك ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «أحطنا ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive [Note: It may be parenthetical between the two clauses conjoined to one another.].
The clause «أتبع ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause (الأمر) كذلك.

safi-cedvel:93-93.t:
* I'rab:
(بين) an adverbial noun, a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative, its governor being بلغ [Note: It is originally a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted qualified noun, i.e. "a place between the two barriers"..], (من دونهما) attached to (mutaʿalliq) (وجد) [Note: Or attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of (قوما).], (يكادون) an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, nominative.. and (الواو) the noun [Translator's note: the source runs on here without punctuation into the next sentence.] The clause «بلغ ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
The clause «وجد ...» has no grammatical position, the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «لا يكادون ...» is in the position of accusative as an adjective of (قوما).
The clause «يفقهون ...» is in the position of accusative as the khabar (predicate) of يكادون.

* Morphology:
(السدّين), dual of السدّ, a primitive (jāmid) noun for the barrier between two things or two waters; its pattern is فعل with fatḥa then sukūn; its plural is أسداد on the pattern أفعال; and السدّ may be with ḍamma, its plural being سدود, and it is then the black cloud that blocks the horizon.

* Benefits:
- Adverbs are of two kinds, of time and of place:
Both kinds are divided into two categories:
fully inflectable (mutaṣarrif) and non-inflectable (ghayr mutaṣarrif):
a- The mutaṣarrif: it is the one that leaves the adverbial function, so it may be an agent, a subject, a predicate or an object, e.g. شهر، يوم، قرن، عصر، سنة، نهار، ليل, etc.
b- The ghayr mutaṣarrif: it is what is bound to the accusative as an adverb, whether indeclinable or declinable, e.g. قط، عوض، بينا، بينما، إذا، أيان، أين، ذات ليلة, and compound adverbs such as صباح مساء and يوم يوم.
c- Among them is what is accusative as an adverb or genitive by «من», such as: «قبل، بعد، the six directions, لدى، لدن، عند، متى، أين، هنا، ثمّ، حيث and الآن». This topic has details that we find in the extensive works, so consult them if you are among their frequenters.

safi-cedvel:94-94.t:
* I'rab:
(ذا) the one addressed (munādā), a muḍāf, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the alif; (في الأرض) attached to (mutaʿalliq) (مفسدون); (الفاء) conjunction; (هل) an interrogative particle; (لك) attached to the second mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the verb نجعل [Note: The verb (نجعل) may be transitive to one object by being made to carry the meaning of ندفع (we pay), so the prepositional phrase is attached to the verb نجعل.], (خرجا) a first direct object, accusative.
The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) (أن تجعل) is in the position of genitive by (على), attached to (نجعل).
(بيننا) an adverb attached to (تجعل), by its being made to carry the meaning of تبني (you build) [Note: Or attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of (سدّا).], (سدّا) a direct object, accusative.
The clause «قالوا ...» has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «the vocative: يا ذا القرنين ...» is in the position of accusative as the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «إنّ يأجوج.. مفسدون» has no grammatical position, the answer to the vocative.
The clause «نجعل ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause that answers the vocative.
The clause «تجعل ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle-relative (أن).

* Morphology:
(يأجوج ومأجوج), it is said they are both foreign words without derivation, and they are diptotes for being proper names and foreign; and it is said they are both Arabic, derived from ajīj al-nār, i.e. its blazing, or from al-awj, which is swiftness of running.. The first then has the pattern يفعول and the second مفعول, and the diptote status is then for being proper names and feminine; it is permissible to pronounce them with or without the hamza.
(خرجا), it is the maṣdar of the triliteral خرج, then used as a noun for money paid, like أجر (wage), or it means مخرج (outlay); its pattern is فعل with fatḥa then sukūn.

safi-cedvel:32-33.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (اضرب) an imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is "you" (أنت); (اللام) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (اضرب); (مثلا) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (رجلين) badal (substitute) of مثلا, accusative «[Note: It may be a second direct object of the verb (اضرب), by making it imply the meaning of اجعل, with a muḍāf omitted, i.e. "the likeness of two men".]», and the sign of the accusative is the yāʾ; (جعلنا) a past verb and its agent; (لأحدهما) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted second direct object..
and (هما) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (جنّتين) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and the sign of the accusative is the yāʾ; (من أعناب) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an adjective of جنّتين; (الواو) circumstantial (ḥāliyya); (حففناهما) like جعلنا, and (هما) is a pronoun, direct object; (بنخل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (حففنا); (الواو) a conjunction; (جعلنا بينهما زرعا) like جعلنا لأحدهما حنتين «[Translator's note: «حنتين» is a misprint in the source for «جنّتين».]», and the adverb بين is attached to an omitted second direct object.
The clause «اضرب ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «جعلنا ...» is in the position of the accusative as an adjective of رجلين «[Note: It may be an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī), so it would have no grammatical position.]».
The clause «حففناهما ...» is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of جنّتين, with (قد) implied.
The clause «جعلنا.. (the second)» is in the position of the accusative, conjoined to the clause حففناهما.
33- (كلتا) mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ), and the sign of the nominative is the implied ḍamma on the alif because it is annexed to an overt noun; (الجنّتين) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr), and the sign of the genitive is the yāʾ; (آتت) a past verb, and (التاء) is for the feminine; it is singular out of regard for the form of كلتا, and the agent is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هي"; (أكلها) mafʿūl bihi, accusative.. and (ها) is muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) a conjunction; (لم) a particle of negation that makes jussive; (تظلم) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), and the agent is "it" (هي); (من) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (تظلم) by making it imply the meaning of تنقص (diminish), and the pronoun refers back to الأكل; (شيئا) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (الواو) a conjunction; (فجرّنا) like جعلنا; (خلالهما) an adverb of place, accusative, attached to (فجّرنا), and (هما) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (نهرا) mafʿūl bihi, accusative.
The clause «كلتا الجنّتين آتت ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption.
The clause «آتت ...» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (كلتا)..
The clause «لم تظلم ...» is in the position of the nominative, conjoined to the clause آتت. The clause «فجّرنا ...» is in the position of the nominative, conjoined to the clause آتت «[Note: It may be a ḥāl, with (قد) implied, in the position of the accusative.]».

* Morphology:
(كلتا): a noun indicating duality while its form is singular; it is used for emphasis (tawkīd) with the feminine, in annexation.

* Rhetoric:
- Completion (tatmīm), precaution (iḥtirās) and metonymy (kināya):
In the saying of Allah the Exalted «وَاضْرِبْ لَهُمْ مَثَلًا رَجُلَيْنِ جَعَلْنا لِأَحَدِهِما جَنَّتَيْنِ».
In this speech it is possible that the two gardens are merely a gathering of dense trees that cover the ground with the shade of their branches, as the linguistic meaning of الجنة requires; then He completed that further with His saying «وَجَعَلْنا بَيْنَهُما زَرْعاً», lest it be imagined that the benefit is limited to date palms and grapes, and so that each of the two gardens would combine staple foods and fruits, continuously cultivated in a beautiful form and elegant arrangement. Then He completed that with His saying «وَفَجَّرْنا خِلالَهُما نَهَراً» to indicate the permanence of benefiting from them, for water is the secret of life. So this man had attained all delights and obtained every kind of blessing. Then He completed that with His saying «كِلْتَا الْجَنَّتَيْنِ آتَتْ أُكُلَها» to evoke the complete picture of benefiting from the resources, and took precaution with His saying «وَلَمْ تَظْلِمْ مِنْهُ شَيْئاً» against there being any shortfall in the produce it gave, and so that it would be a metonymy for the completeness of the two gardens and their growth always and forever. Thus the description of the two gardens fulfilled all three arts together.

safi-cedvel:34-36.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (كان) an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb — an abrogator (nāsikh); (اللام) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of kāna; (ثمر) the delayed noun of kāna, nominative (marfūʿ); (الفاء) a conjunction; (قال) a past verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is "he" (هو); (لصاحبه) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (قال), and (الهاء) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (الواو) circumstantial (ḥāliyya); (هو) a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ (subject); (يحاوره) an imperfect verb, nominative, and (الهاء) is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the agent is "he"; (أنا) a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ; (أكثر) khabar, nominative; (من) a preposition and (الكاف) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (أكثر); (مالا) tamyīz (specification), accusative (manṣūb); (الواو) a conjunction; (أعزّ نفرا) like أكثر مالا, and conjoined to it.
The clause «كان له ثمر ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «هو يحاوره ...» is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).
The clause «يحاوره ...» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (هو).
The clause «أنا أكثر ...» is in the position of the accusative as the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl).
35- (الواو) a conjunction; (دخل) like قال; (جنّته) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and (الهاء) is muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) circumstantial; (هو) a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ; (ظالم) khabar, nominative; (اللام) redundant (zāʾida) for strengthening «[Note: Or an original preposition attached to ظالم.. and al-Jamal permitted attaching it to a ḥāl of the pronoun in ظالم, i.e. "he is wronging, saying to himself"..]», (نفسه) genitive in form, accusative in position, the direct object of the active participle ظالم.. and (الهاء) is muḍāf ilayhi; (قال) like the first; (ما) negative; (أظنّ) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the agent is "I" (أنا); (أن) a maṣdar-forming particle that makes accusative; (تبيد) an imperfect verb, accusative; (ها) for drawing attention; (ذه) a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative as agent; (أبدا) an adverb of time, accusative, attached to the verb تبيد.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تبيد) is in the position of the accusative, standing in place of the two objects of ظنّ «[Note: Or it is the first object, and the second object is implied, i.e. "I think the perishing of this [will be] occurring".]».
The clause «دخل جنّته ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause كان له ثمر.
The clause «هو ظالم ...» is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl of the agent of دخل.
The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «ما أظنّ ...» is in the position of the accusative as the object of saying.
The clause «تبيد ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (أن).
36- (الواو) a conjunction; (ما أظنّ) like the first; (الساعة) first direct object, accusative; (قائمة) second direct object, accusative; (الواو) a conjunction; (اللام) preparing for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa li-l-qasam); (إن) a conditional particle making jussive; (رددت) a past verb, passive, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ).. and (التاء) is a pronoun, the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); (إلى ربّي) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (رددت), and the sign of the genitive is the implied kasra on the letter before the yāʾ.. and (الياء) is muḍāf ilayhi; (اللام) the lām of the oath; (أجدنّ) an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa.. and (النون) is for emphasis, and the agent is "I"; (خيرا) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (من) a preposition and (ها) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (خيرا); (منقلبا) tamyīz, accusative.
The clause «ما أظنّ الساعة ...» is in the position of the accusative, conjoined to the clause of the object of saying.
The clause «رددت ...» is in the position of the accusative, conjoined to the clause ما أظنّ الساعة.
The clause «أجدنّ» has no grammatical position: the response to the oath (jawāb al-qasam).. and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by the apodosis «[Translator's note: so in the source ("دلّ عليه جواب الشرط"); presumably "indicated by the response to the oath" is meant.]».

* Morphology:
(أعزّ): an elative (ism tafḍīl) from the triliteral عزّ; its pattern is أفعل.
(نفرا): a collective noun (ism jamʿ) meaning a group of men, or a clan; its plural is أنفار.
(منقلبا): a noun of place from the five-letter verb انقلب; its pattern is منفعل with ḍamma on the mīm and fatḥa on the ʿayn.

safi-cedvel:37-41.t:
* I'rab:
(قال) a past verb; (له) like the previous, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (قال); (صاحبه) fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ).. and (الهاء) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (وهو يحاوره) its i'rab has passed «[Note: In verse (34) of this sūra.]», (الهمزة) for the rebuking interrogative; (كفرت) a past verb and its agent; (الباء) a preposition; (الذي) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the genitive, attached to (كفرت); (خلقك) a past verb.. and (الكاف) is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the agent is "he" (هو), and it is the referent (ʿāʾid); (من تراب) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (خلقك); (ثمّ) a conjunction; (من نطفة) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to what the preposition before it is attached to, so it is conjoined to it; (ثمّ) like the first; (سوّاك) like خلقك, being indeclinable on the implied fatḥa; (رجلا) second direct object, accusative (manṣūb) «[Note: Or it is a ḥāl (circumstantial), even though it is neither transitory nor derived, because it came after سوّاك, since it would have been possible for Him to fashion him as other than a man.]».
The clause «قال له صاحبه ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «هو يحاوره ...» is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl.
The clause «يحاوره ...» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) (هو).
The clause «كفرت ...» is in the position of the accusative as the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «خلقك ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذي).
The clause «سوّاك ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the ṣila clause.
38- (لكن) a particle of rectification (istidrāk) — with quiescent nūn; أنا — the hamza dropped in connected speech and retained in pause — a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ, in the position of the nominative; (هو) the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn), indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as a second mubtadaʾ; (الله) the Majestic Name, a third mubtadaʾ «[Note: It may be a badal (substitute) of the pronoun هو — or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) — on the basis that the pronoun refers back to the preceding speech, i.e. "the One who created you".]», nominative; (ربّي) the khabar of the mubtadaʾ الله, nominative, and the sign of the nominative is the implied ḍamma on the letter before the yāʾ, and (الياء) is muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) a conjunction; (لا) negative; (أشرك) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the agent is "I" (أنا); (بربّي) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أشرك), and the sign of the genitive is the implied kasra on the letter before the yāʾ..
and (الياء) is muḍāf ilayhi; (أحدا) mafʿūl bihi, accusative.
The clause «لكن أنا هو ...» has no grammatical position: a resumption within the scope of the saying.
The clause «هو الله ربّي ...» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (أنا).
The clause «الله ربّي ...» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (هو).
The clause «لا أشرك ...» is in the position of the nominative, conjoined to the clause الله ربّي.
39- (الواو) a conjunction; (لولا) a particle of incitement (taḥḍīḍ) for rebuke; (إذ) an adverb of past time, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative, attached to (قلت); (دخلت) a past verb and its agent; (جنّتك) mafʿūl bihi, accusative.. and (الكاف) is muḍāf ilayhi; (قلت) like دخلت; (ما) a conditional noun making jussive, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative as a fronted direct object «[Note: Or a relative noun, the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "الأمر"; the clause is the object of saying, and the clause شاء is the ṣila.]», (شاء) a past verb, indeclinable, in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); (الله) the Majestic Name, agent, nominative; (لا) the lā of generic negation; (قوّة) the noun of lā, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative; (إلّا) a particle of restriction; (بالله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar of lā; (إن) a conditional particle making jussive; (ترن) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the protasis, and the sign of the jussive is the dropping of the weak letter, and (النون) is for protection (wiqāya), and (الياء), dropped for lightness, is a pronoun in the position of the accusative as direct object; (أنا) a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl) «[Note: Or borrowed for the position of the accusative as emphasis (tawkīd) of the omitted attached pronoun in (ترني); and it is permissible for (أقلّ) to be a ḥāl, the seeing being visual.]», (أقلّ) second direct object, accusative; (من) a preposition and (الكاف) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (أقلّ); (مالا) tamyīz (specification), accusative; (الواو) a conjunction; (ولدا) conjoined (maʿṭūf) to (مالا), accusative.
The clause «دخلت ...» is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. The clause «قلت ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the previous resumption by the wāw before لولا.
The clause «ما شاء الله» is in the position of the accusative as the object of saying.. and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, its implied form being "كان" or "وقع".
The clause «لا قوّة إلّا بالله» has no grammatical position: a resumption within the scope of the saying.
The clause «إن ترن ...» has no grammatical position: a resumption within the scope of the saying.. and the apodosis is coming.
40- (الفاء) linking the apodosis; (عسى) a frozen (jāmid), incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb; (ربّي) the noun of ʿasā, nominative, and the sign of the nominative is the implied ḍamma on the letter before the yāʾ, and (الياء) is muḍāf ilayhi; (أن) a maṣdar-forming particle that makes accusative; (يؤتين) an imperfect verb, accusative..
and (النون) is for protection, and (الياء) is a pronoun in the position of the accusative as direct object — dropped for lightness; (خيرا) second direct object, accusative; (من جنّتك) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (خيرا), and (الكاف) is muḍāf ilayhi.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يؤتين..) is in the position of the accusative as the khabar of ʿasā.
(الواو) a conjunction; (يرسل) an imperfect verb conjoined to يؤتي, accusative; (على) a preposition and (ها) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (يرسل) «[Note: The pronoun in (عليها) refers back to the garden belonging to the disbeliever, i.e. "He sends upon your garden a calamity (ḥusbān)".]», (حسبانا) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (من السماء) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an adjective of (حسبانا); (الفاء) a conjunction «[Note: Or the fāʾ of causation (sababiyya), the verb after it being accusative by an implied أن after it, and the interpreted maṣdar being conjoined to a maṣdar extracted from the preceding speech, i.e. "perhaps the sending of a calamity upon it will occur, and so its becoming slippery barren ground".]» (تصبح) an incomplete imperfect verb — an abrogator (nāsikh) — accusative, conjoined to يرسل, and its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هي"; (صعيدا) the khabar of the incomplete verb, accusative; (زلقا) naʿt (adjective) of (صعيدا), accusative.
The clause «عسى ربّي ...» is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis — of إن ترن. The clause «يؤتيني ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the particle-relative (أن).
The clause «يرسل ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause يؤتين.
The clause «تصبح ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause يرسل.
41- (أو) a conjunction; (يصبح) like تصبح, and conjoined to it; (ماؤها) the noun of يصبح, nominative, and (ها) is muḍāf ilayhi; (غورا) the khabar of يصبح, accusative; (الفاء) a conjunction; (لن) a particle of negation that makes accusative; (تستطيع) an imperfect verb, accusative, and the agent is "you" (أنت); (اللام) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (طلبا) «[Note: Or attached to a ḥāl of (طلبا) — an adjective placed before what it qualifies.]» «[Translator's note: the source gives no separate parsing of (طلبا) itself; it is the direct object of تستطيع.]».
The clause «يصبح ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause تصبح..
The clause «لن تستطيع ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause يصبح ماؤها..

* Morphology:
(أقلّ): an elative (ism tafḍīl) from the triliteral verb قلّ; its pattern is أفعل, and its ʿayn came quiescent because of the doubling.
(حسبانا): it is either the maṣdar of حسب يحسب, of the bāb of نصر, meaning reckoning, i.e. a measure that Allah decreed and reckoned, namely the judgement to destroy it — this has passed in verse (96) of Sūrat al-Anʿām — or it is the plural of حسبانة, a noun for the thunderbolt, its pattern being فعلانة with ḍamma on the fāʾ; and it was said it is a generic noun (ism jins) on the pattern فعلان with ḍamma on the fāʾ, its singular being حسبانة.
(زلقا): a quasi-participle (ṣifa mushabbaha) from the triliteral زلق; its pattern is فعل with two fatḥas.
(غورا): the maṣdar of غار; it came as an adjective meaning غائر, for intensification; its pattern is فعل with fatḥa then sukūn.
(طلبا): an aurally transmitted (samāʿī) maṣdar of the triliteral verb طلب; its pattern is فعل with two fatḥas.

* Rhetoric:
- Hyperbole (mubālagha):
In the saying of Allah the Exalted «أَوْ يُصْبِحَ ماؤُها غَوْراً».
Where the maṣdar is applied in place of the active participle in «غورا», i.e. غائر (sinking).

safi-cedvel:9-12.t:
* I'rab:
(أم) the disjunctive (munqaṭiʿa) one, in the sense of «بل» plus the hamza; (حسبت) a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); (أنّ) a particle resembling the verb; (أصحاب) the noun of أنّ, accusative (manṣūb); (الكهف) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr); (الرقيم) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to الكهف by the wāw, genitive; (كانوا) a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb... and (الواو) is the noun of كان; (من آياتنا) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of (عجبا), with an omitted muḍāf, i.e. "among the totality of Our signs"; (عجبا) the khabar (predicate) of كان, accusative; it came in the singular form because it is a maṣdar.
The interpreted maṣdar (أنّ أصحاب الكهف) is in the position of accusative, standing in for the two objects of حسبت.
The clause «حسبت ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «كانوا ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of أنّ.
10- (إذ) an adverb of past time, attached to (عجبا) [Note: or it is an adverbial noun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being «اذكر».]; (أوى) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif; (الفتية) fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ); (إلى الكهف) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أوى); (الفاء) a conjunction; (قالوا) a past verb and its fāʿil; (ربّنا) the one addressed (munādā), annexed (muḍāf), accusative... and (نا) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (آتنا) an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the weak letter... and (نا) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; the fāʿil is «أنت»; (من) a preposition; (لدنك) a noun, indeclinable on sukūn, in the position of genitive, attached to a ḥāl of رحمة... and (الكاف) muḍāf ilayhi; (رحمة) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (الواو) a conjunction; (هيّئ) like آت, indeclinable on sukūn; (اللام) a preposition, and (نا) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (هيّئ); (من أمرنا) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (هيّئ) [Note: and من is partitive or marks the starting point... The preposition phrase may also be attached to a ḥāl of (رشدا).], and (نا) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (رشدا) mafʿūl bihi, accusative.
The clause «أوى الفتية ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «قالوا ...» is in the position of genitive, conjoined to the clause «أوى الفتية».
The clause «the vocative and its response» is in the position of accusative as the speech reported by the verb of saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «آتنا ...» has no grammatical position: the response to the vocative.
The clause «هيّئ ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause آتنا.
[11-] (الفاء) a conjunction; (ضربنا) a past verb and its fāʿil; (على آذانهم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (ضربنا) by making it carry the sense of «وضعنا» ("We placed") [Note: and the object of ضربنا is omitted, i.e. "a veil"...], and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (في الكهف) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl of the pronoun in آذانهم; (سنين) an adverb of time, accusative, attached to (ضربنا), the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ, as it is treated like the masculine plural; (عددا) a naʿt (adjective) of سنين meaning "counted", or with an omitted muḍāf, i.e. "possessing number", in which case it is a maṣdar [Note: it may also be a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, i.e. "they are counted a counting".].
The clause «ضربنا ...» is in the position of genitive, conjoined to the clause «قالوا..».
12- (ثمّ) a conjunction; (بعثناهم) like ضربنا... and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (اللام) causal (taʿlīl); (نعلم) an imperfect verb, accusative by an «أن» concealed after the lām; the fāʿil is «نحن», used for majesty; (أيّ) an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative; (الحزبين) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ; (أحصى) a past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa implied on the alif [Note: this is the choice of Abū ʿAlī and al-Zamakhsharī... al-Zajjāj and al-Tibrīzī made it an elative noun (ism tafḍīl), which is not sound, because the elative from a non-triliteral verb is not regular (qiyāsī).]; the fāʿil is «هو»; (اللام) a preposition; (ما) an adverbial maṣdar-forming particle; (لبثوا) like قالوا; (أمدا) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, governed by أحصى.
The interpreted maṣdar (ما لبثوا ...) is in the position of accusative as an adverb of time, attached to a ḥāl of (أمدا) [Note: it may be attached to the verb أحصى; and (ما) may be a relative serving as the object of (أحصى), with (أمدا) a tamyīz (specification) and the lām redundant (zāʾida).].
The clause «بعثناهم ...» is in the position of genitive, conjoined to the clause ضربنا.
The clause «نعلم ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the concealed particle-relative (al-mawṣūl al-ḥarfī) (أن).
The interpreted maṣdar (أن نعلم..) is in the position of genitive by the lām, attached to (بعثناهم).
The clause «أيّ الحزبين أحصى ...» is in the position of accusative, standing in for the two objects of نعلم, whose government has been suspended by the interrogative (أيّ).
The clause «أحصى ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (أيّ).
The clause «لبثوا ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the particle-relative (ما).

* Morphology:
(الكهف): a non-derived (jāmid) noun for a cave in general; its wazn is فعل with fatḥa then sukūn; its plurals are كهوف and أكهف.
(الرقيم): a non-derived noun for the tablet on which the names of the People of the Cave were written. It has been said that it is the name of the valley in which the Companions of the Cave were; it has been said it is the name of the town they left; it has been said it is the name of the mountain; it has been said it is the dirhams that were with the People of the Cave; and it has been said it is the dog that was with them... Its wazn is فعيل, and it has the sense of مفعول when it means the tablet.
(رشدا): a heard (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb رشد يرشد, of the pattern-class فرح; its wazn is فعل with two fatḥas.
(عددا): a derived adjective whose wazn is فعل with two fatḥas, in the sense of مفعول; or it is the maṣdar of the triliteral verb عدّ, meaning "counting".
(الحزبين): dual of الحزب, a collective noun (ism jamʿ) for a group of people; its wazn is فعل with kasra then sukūn; its plural is أحزاب, on the measure أفعال.
(أحصى): it contains iʿlāl by substitution (qalb); its origin is أحصي — with yāʾ —; the yāʾ, being vowelled after a fatḥa, was changed into an alif; its wazn is أفعل.

* Rhetoric:
1- The dependent metaphor (al-istiʿāra al-tabaʿiyya):
In the words of the Exalted «فَضَرَبْنا عَلَى آذانِهِمْ», heavy sleep-inducing is likened to drawing a veil over the ears, as a tent is pitched over its dwellers.
Some allowed it to be of the type of representational metaphor (al-istiʿāra al-tamthīliyya).
2- Attachment (al-taʿlīq):
In the words of the Exalted «ثُمَّ بَعَثْناهُمْ لِنَعْلَمَ أَيُّ الْحِزْبَيْنِ أَحْصى لِما لَبِثُوا أَمَداً», what is meant is not that Allah should come to know something that lies within the scope of His knowledge; rather, He meant that to which the knowledge attaches, namely the matter becoming manifest to them, so that they would increase in faith and in taking heed, and so that this would be among the hidden kindnesses to the believers of their time; or so that the attachment of Our knowledge would occur as a present attachment, i.e. We know that the matter is occurring now, after We knew before that it would occur in future time.

* Benefits:
1- Many grammarians held that «أحصى» is a past verb and أمدا its object:
But Arabic linguistic instinct favours its being an elative noun, with أمدا a tamyīz, even though verbal technicality, as some claim, favours the verb. What we have relied on is a view supported by some pillars of this craft, such as al-Zajjāj, al-Tibrīzī and others. So consider carefully and choose what is correct, may Allah guide you. [Translator's note: so in the source; this contradicts the i'rab and footnote above, which take أحصى as a verb and call the elative view of al-Zajjāj and al-Tibrīzī "not sound".]
2- Al-Mubarrad held that the meaning of «أي» in this verse is "is it this or that?"
What al-Mubarrad intended is that interrogative particles, when they are nouns, are not governed by what precedes them; so consider carefully.

safi-cedvel:13-15.t:
* I'rab:
(نحن) a detached pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (نقصّ) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); the fāʿil (agent) is «نحن», used for majesty; (على) a preposition, and (الكاف) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (نقصّ); (نبأهم) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb)... and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (بالحقّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil or of the object. (إنّهم) a particle resembling the verb... and (هم) a pronoun in the position of accusative as the noun of إنّ; (فتية) khabar (predicate), nominative; (آمنوا) a past verb and its fāʿil; (بربّهم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (آمنوا), and (هم) muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) a conjunction; (زدناهم) a past verb and its fāʿil, and (هم) a pronoun, first mafʿūl bihi; (هدى) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif.
The clause «نحن نقصّ ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «نقصّ ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (نحن).
The clause «إنّهم فتية ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «آمنوا ...» is in the position of nominative as a naʿt (adjective) of فتية.
The clause «زدناهم ...» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause «آمنوا..».
14- (الواو) a conjunction; (ربطنا) like زدنا; (على قلوبهم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (ربطنا)... and (هم) muḍāf ilayhi; (إذ) an adverb of past time, indeclinable, in the position of accusative, attached to (ربطنا); (قاموا) like آمنوا; (الفاء) a conjunction; (قالوا) like آمنوا; (ربّنا) mubtadaʾ, nominative... and (نا) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (ربّ) khabar, nominative; (السموات) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr); (الأرض) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to السموات by the wāw, genitive; (لن) a particle of negation and of the subjunctive; (ندعو) an imperfect verb, accusative; the fāʿil is «نحن»; (من دونه) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl of (إلها), and (الهاء) muḍāf ilayhi; (إلها) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (اللام) the lām of the oath, for an implied oath; (قد) a particle of realization (taḥqīq); (قلنا) like زدنا; (إذا) — with nunation — a particle of response with no governing effect; (شططا) mafʿūl bihi, accusative [Note: it may be a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar, being its qualifier... It may also be a ḥāl of the pronoun of the maṣdar with an omitted muḍāf, i.e. "a saying of extravagance".].
The clause «ربطنا ...» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause آمنوا.
The clause «قاموا ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «قالوا ...» is in the position of genitive, conjoined to the clause قاموا.
The clause «ربّنا ربّ ...» is in the position of accusative as the speech reported by the verb of saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «لن ندعو ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption clarifying the import of the preceding clause.
The clause «قلنا ...» has no grammatical position: the response to an implied oath... and the implied oath clause is the apodosis of an implied condition expressed by (إذا), i.e. "if we called on him, then by Allah we would have said an extravagance".
15- (ها) a particle of alerting (tanbīh); (أولاء) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ; (قومنا) a badal (substitute) of the demonstrative — or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) —, nominative; (اتّخذوا) a past verb and its fāʿil; (من دونه) like the first, attached to a second mafʿūl bihi [Note: it may be attached to an omitted ḥāl of آلهة... or attached to (اتّخذوا) if it is made to carry the sense of «عملوا».]; (آلهة) first mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (لولا) a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ); (يأتون) an imperfect verb, nominative... and (الواو) is the fāʿil; (على) a preposition, and (هم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to a ḥāl of سلطان [Note: there may be an omitted muḍāf in it, i.e. "their worship"...]; (بسلطان) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يأتون); (بيّن) a naʿt of سلطان, genitive; (الفاء) resumptive; (من) an interrogative noun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ; (أظلم) khabar, nominative; (من) a preposition; (من) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to (أظلم); (افترى) a past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa implied on the alif; the fāʿil is «هو», which is the returning pronoun (al-ʿāʾid); (على الله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (افترى); (كذبا) mafʿūl muṭlaq standing in for the maṣdar [Note: see verse (117) of Sūrat Yūnus and (18) of Hūd.], being its synonym.
The clause «هؤلاء قومنا ...» has no grammatical position: a resumption within the scope of the young men's speech.
The clause «اتّخذوا ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (هؤلاء).
The clause «لولا يأتون عليهم ...» has no grammatical position: a resumption within the scope of the young men's speech.
The clause «من أظلم ...» has no grammatical position: a resumption within the scope of the young men's speech.
The clause «افترى ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (من).

* Morphology:
(شططا): a heard (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb in «شطّ فلان في حكمه», i.e. he was unjust and wronged; its wazn is فعل with two fatḥas, and the verb is of the pattern-class ضرب.

* Rhetoric:
- The explicit dependent metaphor (al-istiʿāra al-taṣrīḥiyya al-tabaʿiyya):
In the words of the Exalted: «وَرَبَطْنا عَلى قُلُوبِهِمْ».
Al-rabṭ is tying with a rope. What is meant is: We strengthened their hearts with patience in abandoning their homelands and fleeing with their religion to the cave, and We emboldened them to speak the truth and proclaim it openly before the tyrants.

safi-cedvel:95-97.t:
* I'rab:
(ما) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (فيه) attached to (mutaʿalliq) (مكّنّي), and (الياء) is mafʿūl bihi (direct object) in the verb and muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct) in the noun; (خير) the khabar (predicate) of the subject ما [Note: The thing it is preferred over is omitted together with the preposition, i.e. "better than your tribute".], (الفاء) linking the apodosis of an implied (muqaddar) condition; (بقوّة) attached to (أعينوا); (أجعل) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) as the answer to the request, and the fāʿil (agent) is "I"; (بينكم) an adverb, accusative, attached to the second direct object of (أجعل); (ردما) a first direct object.
The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «ما مكّنّي فيه ربّي ...» is in the position of accusative as the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «مكّني فيه ربّي ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (ما).
The clause «أعينوني ...» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, i.e. "if you seek help, then help me".
The clause «أجعل ...» has no grammatical position, the apodosis of an implied condition not joined with the fāʾ, i.e. "if you help me, I will make..".
96- (زبر) a second direct object, its governor being آتوني; (حتّى) a particle of limit and commencement; (بين) an adverb attached to (ساوى); (نارا) a second direct object, its governor being جعله; (أفرغ) an imperfect verb like أجعل [Note: In (95) of this sūra.] (قطرا) a direct object, its governor being أفرغ, and it is contested (mutanāzaʿ ʿalayhi) by the verb آتوني, because it is the second object in meaning [Note: A pronoun has been implied in the first; had the first been made the governor, a pronoun would necessarily have been implied in the second, i.e. "bring me, I will pour it upon it, molten copper".].
The clause «آتوني زبر ...» has no grammatical position, a resumption within the scope of the saying [Note: The clause may be a badal (substitute) of أعينوني ...].
The clause «ساوى ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position, the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «انفخوا ...» is in the position of accusative as the speech reported.
The clause «جعله ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «قال (the second)» has no grammatical position, the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «آتوني أفرغ ...» is in the position of accusative as the speech reported.
The clause «أفرغ ...» has no grammatical position, the apodosis of an implied condition not joined with the fāʾ, i.e. "if you bring me molten copper, I will pour it upon it".
97- (الفاء) conjunction..
The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) (أن يظهروه) is in the position of accusative as direct object, its governor being اسطاعوا; (له) attached to (نقبا) [Note: Or attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of (نقبا).], which is a direct object, its governor being استطاعوا.
The clause «ما اسطاعوا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to an omitted resumptive clause, i.e. "so the people came intending to pierce it, but they were not able".
The clause «يظهروه ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the particle-relative (أن).
The clause «ما استطاعوا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause ما اسطاعوا.

* Morphology:
(ردما), it is originally the maṣdar of the triliteral ردم, used here in the sense of the earth that blocks, or with which blocking is done; its pattern is فعل with fatḥa then sukūn.
(زبر), plural of زبرة, a primitive (jāmid) noun for a large piece of iron; its pattern is فعلة with ḍamma then sukūn, and the plural is with ḍamma then fatḥa, or with two ḍammas.
(الحديد), a primitive noun for the well-known metal (iron); its pattern is فعيل.
(ساوى), it contains a weak-letter change (iʿlāl) by conversion; its original form is ساوى — with a yāʾ at its end — and when it was voweled and the letter before it had fatḥa, it was converted into an alif; its pattern is فاعل.
(الصدفين), dual of الصدف, a noun for the side of each of the two mountains, because it meets and faces the other, or because it is separated from the other, since الصدف also means inclining; its pattern is فعل with two fatḥas.. It has been read with two ḍammas, and with ḍamma on the first and sukūn on the second.
(قطرا), a noun for molten copper, from (أقطر) al-māʾ when it flowed; its pattern is فعل with kasra then sukūn.
(نقبا), an aurally-transmitted (samāʿī) maṣdar of the verb نقب ينقب, of the pattern-class of naṣara; its pattern is فعل with fatḥa then sukūn.

* Rhetoric:
- The eloquent simile (al-tashbīh al-balīgh):
In the saying of Allah the Exalted «جَعَلَهُ ناراً».
That is, like fire in heat and intense redness; the particle of comparison and the point of resemblance were omitted, so it became balīgh.

* Benefits:
- Dropping letters from words:
The dropping of some letters from some words occurs in the language, either because of the closeness of points of articulation; of this: اسطاع, originally استطاع; and of it is the dropping of the tāʾ of the imperfect when the verb begins with a tāʾ; and of it is the dropping of the nūn of لدن for lightness. This is an aspect whose exhaustive treatment requires effort and time that do not accord with our direction in this book.
of the letters, or their distance or their similarity; and in all of that the aim is to ease pronunciation, make the language pliable and remove obstacles. [Translator's note: the last line appears displaced in the source; it seems to continue the phrase "because of the closeness of points of articulation" above, i.e. "...of the letters, or their distance or their similarity...".]

safi-cedvel:98-98.t:
* I'rab:
(هذا) mubtadaʾ (subject), its khabar (predicate) being (رحمة); (من ربّي) attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of (رحمة); (الفاء) conjunction; (دكّاء) a second mafʿūl bihi (direct object), its governor being جعل; it is denied nunation because its hamza is for the feminine, and it is on the omission of a qualified noun, i.e. "a levelled land"; (الواو) conjunction; (حقّا) the khabar of كان, accusative.
The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «هذا رحمة ...» is in the position of accusative as the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «جاء وعد ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
The clause «جعله ...» has no grammatical position, the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «كان وعد» is in the position of accusative, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause of the condition, its verb and its apodosis, which is itself conjoined to the clause of the speech reported.

* Morphology:
(دكّاء), feminine of أدكّ, on the pattern أفعل, an assimilated adjective (ṣifa mushabbaha) from the triliteral دكّ; the pattern of دكّاء is فعلاء; al-adakk is the camel that has no hump.

safi-cedvel:99-101.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (تركنا) one of the verbs of transformation (afʿāl al-taḥwīl); (يومئذ) an adverb, accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تركنا), and (إذ) is an adverbial noun indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied (muqaddar) sukūn, whose appearance is prevented by the incidental nunation [Note: It is the nunation of compensation (tanwīn al-ʿiwaḍ) for an omitted clause, i.e. "the day when they came out from behind the barrier".], in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (في بعض) attached to (يموج); (نفخ) a past verb, passive; (في الصور) a preposition and its genitive noun, the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); (الفاء) conjunction of immediate sequence (taʿqībiyya); (جمعا) a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative.
The clause «تركنا ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «يموج ...» is in the position of accusative as the second mafʿūl bihi (direct object), its governor being تركنا.
The clause «نفخ في الصور ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the resumptive clause.
The clause «جمعناهم ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause نفخ..
100- (للكافرين) attached to (عرضنا), by its being made to carry the meaning of قرّبنا (we brought near); (عرضا) an absolute object, accusative. The clause «عرضنا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause جمعناهم.
101- (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "هم" (they) [Note: Or it is a naʿt (adjective) of الكافرين, or a badal (substitute) of it, or an ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) to it.. It may also be in the position of accusative by an omitted verb, its implied form being "I censure".], (في غطاء) attached to the khabar of كانت; (عن ذكري) the sign of the genitive is the kasra implied on the letter before the yāʾ; attached to an adjective of (غطاء); (الواو) conjunction — or circumstantial (ḥāliyya) —; (سمعا) a direct object, its governor being يستطيعون, accusative.
The clause «(هم) الذين ...» has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «كانت أعينهم في غطاء» has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «كانوا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the ṣila clause [Note: Or in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), with (قد) understood.].

* Morphology:
(جمعا), an aurally-transmitted (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb جمع; its pattern is فعل with fatḥa then sukūn.
(عرضا), an aurally-transmitted maṣdar of the verb عرض; its pattern is فعل with fatḥa then sukūn.
(غطاء), a primitive (jāmid) noun, originally غطا, and because its verb is غطا يغطو and its maṣdar غطو, the wāw in it was converted into a hamza because it came word-final after a vowelless alif.

* Rhetoric:
- The consequential metaphor (al-istiʿāra al-tabaʿiyya) in the saying of Allah the Exalted «يموج في بعض».
He likened them, because of their great number and their intermingling with one another, to the clashing waves of the sea, and borrowed the word يموج for that. So it contains a consequential metaphor.

* Benefits:
- The verbs of transformation:
The grammarians differed greatly about their two governed words.
a- The majority of grammarians hold that they put in the accusative two objects whose origin is «a mubtadaʾ and a khabar».
b- Some of them took a position of opposition and claimed that their two governed words might not be a mubtadaʾ and khabar; and each party has put forward evidence supporting its view and repelling the other's claim.
"And each has a direction toward which he turns", so race toward the truth once that becomes clear.

safi-cedvel:102-102.t:
* I'rab:
(الهمزة) for the interrogative of rebuke (tawbīkhī); (الفاء) resumptive; the sign of the accusative in (يتّخذوا) is the dropping of the nūn; (عبادي) a first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), the sign of the accusative being the fatḥa implied (muqaddara) on the letter before the yāʾ; (من دوني) attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أولياء) [Note: Or attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of أولياء.], which is a second direct object, and it is denied nunation because it is attached to the feminine with a lengthened ending (al-muʾannath al-mamdūd); (إنّا) a particle resembling the verb, with its noun; (للكافرين) attached to a ḥāl of (نزلا), which is a second direct object, its governor being أعتدنا.
The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) (أن يتّخذوا ...) fills the place of the two objects of حسب.
The clause «حسب الذين كفروا ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive [Note: Or it is conjoined to an implied resumptive clause — in the view of al-Zamakhsharī — i.e. "did they disbelieve, and so think".].
The clause «كفروا ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «يتّخذوا ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the particle-relative (أن).
The clause «إنّا أعتدنا ...» has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «أعتدنا ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of inna.

safi-cedvel:103-104.t:
* I'rab:
(هل) an interrogative particle; (بالأخسرين) attached to (mutaʿalliq) (ننبّئكم), the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ; (أعمالا) a tamyīz (specification), accusative.
The clause «قل ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «ننبّئكم ...» is in the position of accusative as the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl).
104- (الذين) a relative in the position of genitive as a naʿt (adjective) of الأخسرين, or a badal (substitute) of it, or an ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) [Note: Or it is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "هم" (they), or in the position of accusative by an omitted verb, by way of censure.], (في الحياة) attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun in سعيهم [Note: Because the muḍāf is included in the muḍāf ilayhi; it may also be attached to (ضلّ).], and the sign of the genitive in (الدنيا) is the kasra implied (muqaddara) on the alif; (الواو) the wāw of the ḥāl..
The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) (أنّهم يحسنون) is in the position of accusative, filling the place of the two objects of يحسبون.
(صنعا) a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative, its governor being يحسنون.
The clause «ضلّ سعيهم ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «هم يحسبون ...» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of the pronoun in سعيهم.
The clause «يحسبون ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (هم).
The clause «يحسنون ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of (أنّ).

* Morphology:
(الأخسرين), plural of الأخسر, an elative (ism tafḍīl) from the triliteral خسر; its pattern is أفعل; it was put in the plural because it follows what precedes it in meaning, i.e. "of those who are the greatest losers in deeds"; and the bare description, not the comparison, may be intended, i.e. "of the losers in their deeds".
(سعيهم), an aurally-transmitted (samāʿī) maṣdar of the triliteral verb سعى; its pattern is فعل with ḍamma then sukūn [Translator's note: so in the source; سعي is commonly vocalized with fatḥa then sukūn.], (صنعا), an aurally-transmitted maṣdar of the triliteral verb صنع; its pattern is فعل with ḍamma then sukūn, and there is another maṣdar with fatḥa on the ṣād.

* Rhetoric:
Incomplete paronomasia (al-jinās al-nāqiṣ):
In the saying of Allah the Exalted «وَهُمْ يَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّهُمْ يُحْسِنُونَ صُنْعاً».
It is called jinās al-taṣḥīf (paronomasia of dotting), in which the dots are what distinguish the two words; the vowelling and the dots have changed between the two words.

* Benefits:
We alluded in an earlier discussion to the tamyīz of number in its kinds. Here we point to the tamyīz in general with respect to singular and plural, i.e. its occurring singular or plural — our discussion concerns the accusative tamyīz only —.
a- If it occurs after the tens from twenty to ninety, it is only singular, e.g. «اشتريت عشرين ثوبا» (I bought twenty garments), since the quantity is known from the number, and the tamyīz is mentioned only to identify the kind.
b- If it explains a quality or one of the meanings, both singular and plural are permitted in it: if you put it in the plural you indicate the kind of the specified thing and its being plural, e.g. «هَلْ نُنَبِّئُكُمْ بِالْأَخْسَرِينَ أَعْمالًا», and if you put it in the singular you indicate the kind only, e.g. «أنا أكثر منك مالا» (I have more wealth than you).

safi-cedvel:105-105.t:
* I'rab:
(أولئك) a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject), its khabar (predicate) being the relative (الذين); (بآيات) attached to (mutaʿalliq) (كفروا); (الفاء) conjunction in both places; (لهم) attached to (نقيم), and likewise the adverb يوم; (وزنا) a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative.
The clause «أولئك الذين ...» has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «كفروا ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «حبطت أعمالهم ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the ṣila clause.
The clause «لا نقيم ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause, linked to it by a causal link.

safi-cedvel:42-42.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (أحيط) a past verb, passive, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو"; (بثمره) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أحيط), by making it imply the meaning of فجع (to be stricken) «[Note: Or attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the deputy agent, i.e. "stricken in his fruit".]», and (الهاء) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (الفاء) a conjunction; (أصبح) an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, an abrogator (nāsikh), and its noun is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو"; (يقلّب) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the fāʿil (agent) is "he" (هو); (كفّيه) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), and the sign of the accusative is the yāʾ, and (الهاء) is muḍāf ilayhi; (على) a preposition; (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the genitive, attached to (يقلّب) «[Note: Or a maṣdar-forming particle, and the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of the genitive; and it is permissible for the preposition to be attached to an omitted ḥāl, i.e. "lamenting".]» in the sense of يندم (regrets); (أنفق) a past verb, and the agent is "he"; (في) a preposition and (ها) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (أنفق); (الواو) circumstantial (ḥāliyya); (هي) a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (خاوية) khabar (predicate), nominative; (على عروشها) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (خاوية).. and (ها) is muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) a conjunction; (يقول) like يقلّب; (يا) for drawing attention; (ليتني) a particle of wishing that makes accusative, and (النون) is for protection (wiqāya), and (الياء) is a pronoun, the noun of layta, in the position of the accusative; (لم) a particle of negation that makes jussive; (أشرك) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), and the agent is "I" (أنا); (بربّي) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أشرك), and (الياء) is muḍāf ilayhi; (أحدا) mafʿūl bihi, accusative.
The clause «أحيط ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «أصبح ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «يقلّب ...» is in the position of the accusative as the khabar of aṣbaḥa.
The clause «أنفق ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (ما).
The clause «هي خاوية ...» is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl of the pronoun in (فيها).
The clause «يقول ...» is in the position of the accusative, conjoined to the clause يقلّب.
The clause «ليتني لم أشرك ...» is in the position of the accusative as the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «لم أشرك ...» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of layta.

* Rhetoric:
- Metonymy (kināya):
In the saying of Allah the Exalted «يُقَلِّبُ كَفَّيْهِ».
In the speech there is a metonymy for lament and regret, because the one who regrets strikes his right hand on his left.

safi-cedvel:43-43.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (لم) a particle of negation that makes jussive; (تكن) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm); (اللام) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) a fronted khabar (predicate); (فئة) the noun of takun, nominative (marfūʿ); (ينصرونه) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and (الواو) is the fāʿil (agent), and (الهاء) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (الواو) a conjunction; (ما) negative; (كان) an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, and its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو"; (منتصرا) the khabar of kāna, accusative (manṣūb).
The clause «لم تكن له فئة ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «ينصرونه ...» is in the position of the nominative as a naʿt (adjective) of فئة.
The clause «ما كان منتصرا ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the resumptive clause «[Note: It may be a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the third-person pronoun in (ينصرونه).]».

* Morphology:
(منتصرا): an active participle from the five-letter verb انتصر; its pattern is مفتعل with ḍamma on the mīm and kasra on the ʿayn.

safi-cedvel:44-44.t:
* I'rab:
(هنالك) a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the accusative as an adverb of place, attached to (mutaʿalliq) a fronted khabar (predicate) «[Note: It may be attached to (منتصرا), with the pause at the adverb.]», (الولاية) a delayed mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ) «[Note: Or a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is the preposition and its genitive noun لله.]», (لله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of الولاية, its governing factor being the [implied] "being settled" (al-istiqrār); (الحقّ) naʿt (adjective) of the Majestic Name, genitive (majrūr); (هو) a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ; (خير) khabar, nominative; (ثوابا) tamyīz (specification), accusative (manṣūb); (الواو) a conjunction; (خير) conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the first; (عقبا) tamyīz, accusative.
The clause «هنالك الولاية ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «هو خير ...» has no grammatical position: causal (taʿlīliyya).

* Morphology:
(عقبا): the noun from عقب يعقب, of the bābs of نصر and ضرب, meaning outcome and recompense; its pattern is فعل with ḍamma then sukūn, or with two ḍammas.

* Benefits:
1- A parable and a dialogue:
After Allah asked His Prophet «to keep himself patient», He struck for him a parable: «رَجُلَيْنِ جَعَلْنا لِأَحَدِهِما جَنَّتَيْنِ مِنْ أَعْنابٍ». There is disagreement about the names of these two men and their identification. It was said:
It was revealed about two brothers from the people of Mecca, of Banū Makhzūm, one of them a believer, namely Abū Salama, the husband of Umm Salama before the Prophet ﷺ, and the other a disbeliever, namely al-Aswad ibn ʿAbd al-Asad; and they are the two brothers mentioned in Sūrat al-Ṣāffāt.
Each of them inherited four thousand dinars; one of them spent his wealth in the way of Allah and asked his brother for something, and he said to him what he said.
It was also said: it is a parable for all who believe in Allah and all who disbelieve.. And it was said: they are two men of the Children of Israel, one a believer and the other a disbeliever; the believer's name was «Tamlīkhā» and the disbeliever's name «Qarṭūsh». They had been partners, then they divided the wealth, so each of them had three thousand dinars. The believer bought slaves for a thousand and freed them, bought clothes for a thousand and clothed the naked, bought food for a thousand and fed the hungry, built mosques and did good. As for the disbeliever, he married wealthy women, bought riding animals and cattle and bred them, and they increased for him excessively, until he surpassed the people of his time in wealth.
Need overtook the believer, so he said: "Let me go to my brother and work as a guard in one of his gardens." But the disbeliever turned him away in a hideous manner, deprived him, and declared his disbelief and denial.
Then there happened in the story of this rich man what Allah mentioned of the destruction encompassing his fruit and the loss of the roots of its trees, through the calamity (ḥusbān) He sent upon it from the sky.
Allah struck this parable accompanied by the dialogue, which lent the story splendour and brilliance, sweetness, radiance and enchantment.
2- كلا and كلتا:
They are two words declined like the dual, on condition that they are annexed to a pronoun. If they are annexed to an overt noun, they are declined like the shortened noun (ism maqṣūr), with vowels implied on the alif. Their form is singular and their meaning dual; therefore it is permissible to predicate of them with a singular pronoun or a dual pronoun, as in:
كلاهما حين جدّ الجدّ بينهما ... قد أقلعا وكلا أنفيهما رابي
(Both of them, when the matter grew serious between them, desisted, while each of their noses was swollen [with anger].)
However, regard for the form is preferable, and the Noble Qur'an came with it in the verses we are dealing with, in the saying of Allah the Exalted «كِلْتَا الْجَنَّتَيْنِ آتَتْ أُكُلَها», where the predication about them came in the singular.

safi-cedvel:45-45.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (اضرب لهم مثل) its i'rab has passed «[Note: In verse (32) of this sūra.]», (الحياة) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr); (الدنيا) naʿt (adjective) of الحياة, genitive, and the sign of the genitive is the implied kasra on the alif; (كماء) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) a second mafʿūl bihi (direct object), its governing factor being اضرب in the sense of اجعل «[Note: Or it is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "it is like water".. and the clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of مثل, the verb being a verb transitive to one object, like اذكر..]» (أنزلناه) a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its object; (من السماء) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أنزلناه); (الفاء) a conjunction; (اختلط) a past verb; (الباء) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (اختلط); (نبات) agent, nominative (marfūʿ); (الأرض) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (الفاء) a conjunction; (أصبح) an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb — an abrogator (nāsikh) — and its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو", i.e. the vegetation; (هشيما) the khabar of aṣbaḥa, accusative (manṣūb); (تذروه) an imperfect verb, nominative; (الرياح) agent, nominative.. and (الهاء) in (تذروه) is a pronoun, direct object; (الواو) resumptive; (كان) like أصبح; (الله) the Majestic Name, the noun of kāna; (على كلّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (مقتدرا), which is the khabar of kāna, accusative «[Translator's note: the source gives no separate parsing of (شيء); it is muḍāf ilayhi of كلّ.]».
The clause «اضرب ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «أنزلناه ...» is in the position of the genitive as an adjective of (ماء).
The clause «اختلط.. نبات.....» is in the position of the genitive, conjoined to the clause أنزلناه.
The clause «أصبح ...» is in the position of the genitive, conjoined to the clause اختلط.
The clause «تذروه الرياح ...» is in the position of the accusative as an adjective of (هشيما).
The clause «كان الله ... مقتدرا» has no grammatical position: resumptive.

* Morphology:
(هشيما): a primitive (jāmid) noun; it is فعيل in the sense of مفعول, a collective noun (ism jamʿ) whose singular is هشيمة.
(مقتدرا): an active participle from the five-letter verb اقتدر; its pattern is مفتعل with ḍamma on the mīm and kasra on the ʿayn.

* Rhetoric:
- The inverted representative simile (al-tashbīh al-tamthīlī al-maqlūb):
In the saying of Allah the Exalted «وَاضْرِبْ لَهُمْ مَثَلَ الْحَياةِ الدُّنْيا كَماءٍ أَنْزَلْناهُ مِنَ السَّماءِ فَاخْتَلَطَ بِهِ نَباتُ الْأَرْضِ».
The state of this world in its freshness and splendour, and the destruction and extinction that follow it, was likened to the state of vegetation that is green, fresh and intensely green, then dries, withers and wilts, then becomes dry stubble that the winds blow away as if it had never been.
It is an inverted simile, because the apparent expression for this meaning would have been to say: "so it mingled with the vegetation of the earth", since what is known in linguistic convention and usage is that the bāʾ enters upon the abundant thing, not the incidental one; and although by original coinage each of the two intermingling things truly is both "mingling" and "mingled with", what is in the Noble Text was chosen for hyperbole in the abundance of the water, as though it were the abundant base.

safi-cedvel:16-16.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (إذ) an adverb of past time, indeclinable (mabnī), attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted verb, its implied form being "some of them said to others", in the position of accusative; (اعتزلتموهم) a past verb and its fāʿil (agent), and (الواو) is redundant (zāʾida), lengthening the vowel of the mīm... and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (الواو) a conjunction; (ما) a relative noun in the position of accusative, conjoined to the object pronoun [Note: (ما) may be a maṣdar-forming particle, the interpreted maṣdar being conjoined to the object pronoun.]; (يعبدون) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ)... and (الواو) is the fāʿil, and the returning pronoun (al-ʿāʾid) is omitted; (إلّا) a particle of exception; (الله) the Name of Majesty, excepted (mustathnā), accusative (manṣūb), from ما or from the returning pronoun; (الفاء) linking the apodosis of an implied condition; (ائووا) an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn... and (الواو) is the fāʿil; (إلى الكهف) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (ائووا); (ينشر) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) as the response to the command; (اللام) a preposition, and (كم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (ينشر); (ربّكم) fāʿil, nominative... and (كم) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (من رحمته) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (ينشر), and (الهاء) muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) a conjunction; (يهيّئ) an imperfect verb, jussive, conjoined to (ينشر); the fāʿil is «هو»; (من أمركم مرفقا) like «من أمرنا رشدا» [Note: in verse (10) of the sūra.], and the preposition phrase is attached to (يهيّئ) [Note: or attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of (مرفقا)].
The clause «اعتزلتموهم ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. The clause «يعبدون ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (ما). The clause «ائووا ...» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, i.e. "if you have withdrawn from the disbelievers and what they worship, then take refuge".
The clause «ينشر ...» has no grammatical position: the apodosis of an implied condition, not joined with the fāʾ [Note: some make such a clause an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī) of the preceding command.], i.e. "if you take refuge, He will spread out..."
The clause «يهيّئ لكم ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause ينشر.

* Morphology:
(فأووا): it contains the dropping of the connective hamza (hamzat al-waṣl); its origin is ائووا; when the fāʾ preceded it, the connective hamza was dropped, and the second hamza came to be written on an alif as though it were at the beginning of the word. It also contains iʿlāl by deletion, because the imperfect is يأوي, and the imperative attributed to the plural wāw should properly be ائويوا... then the vowel of the yāʾ was transferred to the wāw before it, and when two quiescent letters met the yāʾ was dropped; its wazn is افعوا.
(مرفقا): that on which one leans, i.e. reclines upon, and by which one is helped, such as a human limb from the arm, or what one benefits from of food and drink. Its wazn is مفعل with kasra on the mīm and fatḥa on the ʿayn, and it is used as a non-derived (jāmid) noun; if the mīm is given fatḥa, it is a mīmī maṣdar.

safi-cedvel:17-18.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (ترى) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif; the fāʿil (agent) is «أنت»; (الشمس) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (إذا) an adverb of future time not containing the sense of condition [Note: the adverb may contain the sense of condition, in which case it is attached to (تزاور), the apodosis.], in the position of accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (ترى); (طلعت) a past verb, and (التاء) marks the feminine; the fāʿil is «هي»; (تزاور) an imperfect verb, nominative — one of the two tāʾs has been dropped from it —; the fāʿil is «هي»; (عن كهفهم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تزاور), and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (ذات) an adverb, accusative, attached to (تزاور); (اليمين) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr); (الواو) a conjunction; (إذا غربت تقرضهم ذات الشمال) like its earlier counterpart, and the pronoun (هم) in the verb is mafʿūl bihi; (الواو) the wāw of ḥāl; (هم) a detached pronoun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (في فجوة) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ هم; (من) a preposition, and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to a naʿt (adjective) of (فجوة); (ذلك) a demonstrative in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ — the reference is to the inclining away and the passing by —, (اللام) for distance, and (الكاف) for address; (من آيات) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar of the mubtadaʾ ذلك; (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (من) a jussive conditional noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi placed first; (يهد) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the weak letter; (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative; (الفاء) linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (هو) like هم; (المهتد) the khabar of هو, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied on the yāʾ, which was dropped for lightness in keeping with the pausal pronunciation; (الواو) a conjunction; (من يضلل) like «من يهد», the sign of the jussive being the sukūn; (الفاء) linking the apodosis; (لن) a particle of negation and of the subjunctive; (تجد) an imperfect verb, accusative; the fāʿil is «أنت»; (اللام) a preposition, and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted second mafʿūl bihi; (وليّا) first mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (مرشدا) a naʿt of (وليّا), accusative like it.
The clause «ترى ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «طلعت ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «تزاور ...» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil of ترى.
The clause «غربت ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «تقرضهم ...» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of the fāʿil of ترى.
The clause «هم في فجوة ...» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl.
The clause «ذلك من آيات الله» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «يهد الله ...» has no grammatical position: causal (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «هو المهتدي» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «يضلل ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause «يهد الله».
The clause «لن تجد ...» is in the position of jussive as the second apodosis, joined with the fāʾ.
18- (الواو) a conjunction; (تحسبهم) an imperfect verb, nominative... and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; the fāʿil is «أنت»; (أيقاظا) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (الواو) circumstantial (ḥāliyya); (هم) a pronoun, mubtadaʾ; (رقود) khabar, nominative; (الواو) a conjunction; (نقلّبهم) an imperfect verb, nominative... and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; the fāʿil is «نحن», used for majesty; (ذات اليمين) like the first one in the previous verse, attached to (نقلّبهم); (ذات الشمال) like ذات اليمين and conjoined to it; (الواو) a conjunction; (كلبهم) mubtadaʾ, nominative... and (هم) muḍāf ilayhi; (باسط) khabar, nominative; (ذراعيه) mafʿūl bihi of the active participle باسط [Note: although it is past, it is in the status of the present, being a narration of the past as present (maḥkiyy), i.e. "their dog stretches out its forelegs".], accusative, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ...
and (الهاء) muḍāf ilayhi; (بالوصيد) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (باسط); (لو) a non-jussive conditional particle; (اطّلعت) a past verb and its fāʿil; (على) a preposition, and (هم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (اطّلعت); (اللام) occurring in the apodosis of لو; (ولّيت) like اطّلعت; (منهم) like عليهم, attached to (وليت); (فرارا) mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar, being its synonym [Note: or it is a maṣdar in the place of an emphasizing ḥāl of the fāʿil of ولّيت... or a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose).]; (الواو) a conjunction; (اللام) like the first; (ملئت) a past verb, passive... and (التاء) is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); (منهم) like عليهم, attached to (ملئت), and من is causal; (رعبا) tamyīz (specification), accusative [Note: or a mafʿūl bihi; it was the second object of the active-voice verb.], accusative.
The clause «تحسبهم ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause «ترى الشمس».
The clause «هم رقود» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl.
The clause «نقلّبهم ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause «تحسبهم..».
The clause «كلبهم باسط ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause «تحسبهم..».
The clause «اطّلعت ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «ولّيت ...» has no grammatical position: the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.

* Morphology:
(تزاور): it contains the dropping of one of the two tāʾs; its origin is تتزاور, meaning "it inclines".
(فجوة): a non-derived (jāmid) noun meaning "the wide space of the cave"; its wazn is فعلة with fatḥa then sukūn; its plurals are فجاء with kasra on the fāʾ, and فجوات... like قصعة, قصاع and قصعات.
(مرشدا): an active participle of the quadriliteral أرشد; its wazn is مفعل with ḍamma on the mīm and kasra on the ʿayn.
(أيقاظا): plural of يقظ, an assimilated adjective (ṣifa mushabbaha) from the verb يقظ ييقظ, of the pattern-class فرح; its wazn is فعل with fatḥa then kasra, and the wazn of أيقاظ is أفعال.
(رقود): plural of راقد, an active participle of the triliteral رقد; its wazn is فاعل, and the wazn of رقود is فعول with ḍamma on the fāʾ.
(كلبهم): a non-derived noun for the well-known animal; its wazn is فعل with fatḥa then sukūn; its plurals are كلاب with kasra on the kāf, and أكلب with ḍamma on the lām; the plural of the plural is أكالب with kasra on the lām, and كلابات.
(ذراعيه): dual of ذراع, a non-derived noun for the well-known limb; its wazn is فعال with kasra on the fāʾ.
(الوصيد): a noun for the courtyard or the threshold of the door; it has been said it is the earth; its wazn is فعيل.
(اطّلعت): it contains the substitution (ibdāl) of the tāʾ of the iftiʿāl form by a ṭāʾ, since it comes after a ṭāʾ; its wazn is افتعلت and its origin is اطتلعت.
(فرارا): a heard (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the triliteral verb فرّ. There is an approximate rule about it: its being on the wazn فعال with kasra on the fāʾ indicates refusal and abstention.

* Rhetoric:
1- Antithesis (al-ṭibāq):
In the words of the Exalted «أَيْقاظاً ... رُقُودٌ».
2- Simile (al-tashbīh):
In the words of the Exalted «وَتَحْسَبُهُمْ أَيْقاظاً».
There is a simile in the speech, in which the particle of comparison is one of the verbs of doubt and certainty. You say:
«حسبت زيدا في جرأته الأسد، وعمرا في جوده الغمام» ("I deemed Zayd, in his boldness, the lion, and ʿAmr, in his generosity, the rain-cloud"). The upshot of that is a comparison of Zayd to the lion and of ʿAmr to the rain-cloud. In the verse the upshot is a comparison of the People of the Cave in their state of sleep to those who are awake, in some of their attributes, because it has been said that their eyes were open while they slept.

* Benefits:
Listen to this useful dialogue between the Basrans and the Kufans:
Al-Kisāʾī says: the active participle governs as its verb does, even if it is in past time.
He adduced as proof of the correctness of his claim the words of the Exalted: «وَكَلْبُهُمْ باسِطٌ ذِراعَيْهِ بِالْوَصِيدِ». The Basrans rejected al-Kisāʾī's statement and said: although the event occurred in past time, the verse comes as a narration of the past as present (ḥikāyat al-ḥāl). They adduced two proofs for the correctness of their view. The first: that the wāw in «وَكَلْبُهُمْ» is the wāw of ḥāl. The second: that Allah expressed it with the present form in the words of the Exalted «ونقلبهم», and did not say «وقلبناهم».

safi-cedvel:106-106.t:
* I'rab:
(ذلك) a demonstrative, the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "the matter", and the reference is to the nullification of the deeds [Note: Or it is a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is the clause جزاؤهم جهنّم.. or its khabar is جزاؤهم.. or its khabar is جهنّم if جزاؤهم is parsed as a badal (substitute) of the demonstrative.], (جزاء) mubtadaʾ, its khabar being جهنّم [Note: Or it is a badal of the demonstrative — or an ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) — nominative.. or it is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ ذلك, and (جهنّم) is a badal of جزاء.], (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle.
The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) (ما كفروا..) is in the position of genitive by the bāʾ, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (جزاؤهم) [Note: There is nothing preventing the attachment despite the separation, because this separating element is not foreign to the maṣdar, as it is its predicate.].
