(الواو) conjunction — or resumptive —; (آياتي) a first object, its governor being اتّخذوا, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the kasra implied (muqaddara) on the letter before the yāʾ [Translator's note: so in the source; elsewhere the book gives the implied fatḥa as the accusative sign, as for رسلي next.]; (رسلي) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to آياتي, the sign of the accusative being the fatḥa implied on the letter before the yāʾ; (هزوا) a second mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative.
The clause «(الأمر) ذلك ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «جزاؤهم جهنّم ...» has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī) [Note: Or the khabar of the mubtadaʾ ذلك.].
The clause «كفروا ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle-relative (ما).
The clause «اتّخذوا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause كفروا [Note: Or it is resumptive with no grammatical position.].

safi-cedvel:107-108.t:
* I'rab:
(لهم) attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of كانت [Note: It may be attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of (نزلا) if that is parsed as the khabar of (كانت).], (نزلا) a ḥāl, accusative, of جنّات, on the omission of a muḍāf, i.e. "possessing hospitality" [Note: It may be the khabar of (كانت).].
The clause «إنّ الذين.. كانت» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «آمنوا ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «عملوا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the ṣila clause.
The clause «كانت ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of inna.
108- (خالدين) a ḥāl, accusative, of the pronoun in (لهم), the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ; (فيها) attached to (خالدين); (عنها) attached to a ḥāl of (حولا), which is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), its governor being يبغون, accusative.
The clause «لا يبغون ...» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of the pronoun in خالدين or in (لهم).

* Morphology:
(الفردوس), a name for Paradise. Qatāda said: al-Firdaws is the elevated part of Paradise. Al-Mubarrad said: al-Firdaws, according to what I heard from the Arabs, is densely intertwined trees, mostly grapevines. There is disagreement about it: it is said to be Arabic, and it is said to be foreign, and it is said Persian, and it is said Syriac.. Its plural is فراديس..
(حولا), a noun of maṣdar (ism maṣdar) from the five-letter (تحوّل), meaning "moving away"; and it is said to be an aurally-transmitted (samāʿī) maṣdar of the five-letter تحوّل. Its pattern is فعل with kasra then fatḥa.

safi-cedvel:109-109.t:
* I'rab:
(لو) a non-jussive conditional particle; (لكلمات) attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of (مدادا); (ربّي) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive, the sign of the genitive being the kasra implied (muqaddara) on the letter before the yāʾ; (اللام) occurring in the apodosis of لو; (قبل) an adverb, accusative, attached to (نفد).
The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) (أن تنفد..) is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
(الواو) the wāw of the ḥāl (circumstantial); (بمثله) attached to (جئنا); (مددا) a tamyīz (specification), accusative.
The clause «قل ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «كان البحر ...» is in the position of accusative as the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «نفد البحر ...» has no grammatical position, the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «تنفد كلمات ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle-relative (أن).
The clause «جئنا ...» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl [Note: It may be resumptive, so it has no grammatical position.].. and the apodosis of the condition is omitted, its implied form being "it would be exhausted".

* Morphology:
(مدادا), a noun for that with which one writes, i.e. ink; its pattern is فعال with kasra on the first radical; and the aurally-transmitted (samāʿī) maṣdar of the verb مادّه, meaning مدّه (he extended/supplied it), may be intended by it.

* Benefits:
1- The joining of the apodosis of «لو» with the lām:
a- Its apodosis does not cease to be past, either in meaning or in form.
b- Its apodosis comes affirmative and negative.
1- If it is affirmative, its being joined with the «lām» is predominant, and it is rare for it to be stripped of the lām. This lām has been called the lām of deferral (lām al-taswīf), because its presence conveys delay in the apodosis and its omission conveys speed in it.
The first: e.g. «لَوْ نَشاءُ لَجَعَلْناهُ حُطاماً».
The second: e.g. «لَوْ نَشاءُ جَعَلْناهُ أُجاجاً..».
2- If the apodosis of «لو» is negated by «ما», it is mostly stripped of the lām, and less often joined with it. The frequent case, e.g.: «وَلَوْ شاءَ رَبُّكَ ما فَعَلُوهُ». The infrequent case, e.g.:
ولو نعطى الخيار لما افترقنا ... ولكن لا خيار مع الليالي
(Had we been given the choice, we would not have parted — but there is no choice with the nights.)
Remark: contrary to what we established, that its apodosis is a past verb, its apodosis may come as a nominal clause joined with the lām, e.g. «لَوْ أَنَّهُمْ آمَنُوا وَاتَّقَوْا لَمَثُوبَةٌ مِنْ عِنْدِ اللَّهِ». There is a disagreement about that which it is not in our interest to plunge into.
2- كَلِماتُ رَبِّي — thought almost loses its way in the dimensions of this verse and its extent:
Is not everything that happens in this universe — remote in its past eternities, limitless in its future eternities, vast in its extremities and dimensions, in which we can scarcely perceive a beginning or an end — is not every movement or stillness in it, however small, down to the atom, or however large, up to the galaxy, is not all of that, what we can conceive and what we cannot, all of it issuing in response to the words of Allah, uttered and unuttered, heard and unheard, countable and uncountable? So conceive with me, if you are one who conceives well, and marvel — you and every one capable of marvelling — at the number of the words of Allah and their multitude, if the word "multitude" can express the number of the words of Allah, for which the sea would be exhausted while His words would not be exhausted, even if We brought the like of it as a supplement.
(مددا), a noun of maṣdar (ism maṣdar) of the quadriliteral verb أمدّ, meaning help, succour and increase; its pattern is فعل with two fatḥas.

safi-cedvel:110-110.t:
* I'rab:
(إنّما) a restraining particle and the restrained particle (kāffa wa-makfūfa); (مثلكم) a naʿt (adjective) of بشر, nominative; (يوحى) an imperfect verb, passive, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddara) on the alif; (إليّ) attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يوحى); (إنّما) like إنّما, but (ما) did not take (أنّ) out of its maṣdar-forming function [Note: Al-ʿUkbarī mentioned that, and al-Suyūṭī and al-Jamal followed him.].
The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) (أنّما إلهكم إله ...) is in the position of nominative as nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), i.e. "the oneness of Allah is revealed to me".
(الفاء) resumptive; (من) a jussive conditional noun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (كان) an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); (الفاء) linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and (اللام) the lām of command; (عملا) a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative; (الواو) conjunction; (لا) possibly negating or prohibitive; (بعبادة) attached to (يشرك); (أحدا) a direct object, its governor being يشرك, accusative.
The clause «قل ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «أنا بشر ...» is in the position of accusative as the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «يوحى إليّ ...» is in the position of nominative as a second khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ أنا [Note: Or it has no position, being an explanatory resumption of the preceding saying.].
The clause «من كان ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «كان يرجو ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من) [Note: The predicate may be the two clauses of the condition and the apodosis together.].
The clause «يرجو لقاء ...» is in the position of accusative as the khabar of كان.
The clause «ليعمل ...» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «لا يشرك ...» is in the position of jussive, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the apodosis clause.

safi-cedvel:46-49.t:
* I'rab:
(المال) mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ); (البنون) conjoined (maʿṭūf) to المال by the wāw, and the sign of the nominative is the wāw; (زينة) khabar (predicate), nominative; (الحياة) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr); (الدنيا) like the previous «[Note: In the previous verse (45).]», (الواو) a conjunction; (الباقيات) mubtadaʾ, nominative; (الصالحات) naʿt (adjective) of الباقيات, nominative; (خير) khabar, nominative; (عند) an adverb, accusative (manṣūb), attached to (mutaʿalliq) (خير); (ربّك) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive.. and (الكاف) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (ثوابا وخير أملا) the i'rab of its counterpart has passed «[Note: In verse (44) of this sūra.]».
The clause «المال.. زينة ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «الباقيات.. خير ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the resumptive clause.
47- (الواو) resumptive — or a conjunction; (يوم) mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "اذكر" «[Note: Or it is conjoined to the adverb (عند ربّك), so it is attached to what that is attached to.]», (نسيّر) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil (agent) is "we" (نحن) for majesty; (الجبال) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (الواو) a conjunction; (ترى) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the sign of the nominative is the implied ḍamma on the alif, and the agent is "you" (أنت); (الأرض) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (بارزة) ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative; (الواو) circumstantial (ḥāliyya); (حشرناهم) a past verb and its agent, and (هم) is a pronoun, direct object; (الفاء) a conjunction; (لم) a particle of negation that makes jussive; (نغادر) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), and the agent is "we" for majesty; (من) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to a ḥāl of (أحدا), which is the direct object, accusative.
The clause «(اذكر) يوم ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «نسيّر ...» is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «ترى ...» is in the position of the genitive, conjoined to the clause نسيّر.
The clause «حشرناهم» is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl, with (قد) implied.
The clause «نغادر ...» is in the position of the accusative, conjoined to the clause حشرناهم.
48- (الواو) a conjunction; (عرضوا) a past verb, passive, and (الواو) is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); (على ربّك) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb عرضوا.. and (الكاف) is muḍāf ilayhi; (صفّا) a ḥāl, accusative, of the deputy agent «[Note: It is originally a maṣdar (verbal noun) interpreted as a derived word, i.e. "lined up", or else with its emphasizing repetition omitted, i.e. "row upon row".]», (اللام) occurring in the response to an implied oath; (قد) a particle of verification; (جئتم) a past verb and its agent, and (الواو) is redundant (zāʾida), a lengthening of the vowel of the mīm, and (نا) is a pronoun, direct object; (الكاف) a preposition; (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle; (خلقنا) like جئتم.. and (كم) is a pronoun, direct object; (أوّل) mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative, standing in for the maṣdar, being its adjective, i.e. "We created you a first creation".
The interpreted maṣdar (ما خلقناكم..) is in the position of the genitive by the kāf, attached to an omitted absolute object whose governing factor is جئتمونا.. i.e. "We resurrected you, our resurrecting, like Our bringing you into being the first time".
(بل) a particle of transitional digression (iḍrāb intiqālī); (زعمتم) like جئتم; (أن) lightened from the heavy [أنّ], and its noun is the omitted pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn); (لن) a particle of negation that makes accusative; (نجعل) an imperfect verb, accusative, and the agent is "we" for majesty; (اللام) a preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to an omitted second direct object; (موعدا) first direct object, accusative.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن لن نجعل ...) is in the position of the accusative, standing in place of the two objects of زعمتم.
The clause «عرضوا ...» is in the position of the genitive, conjoined to the clause نسيّر.
The clause «جئتمونا ...» has no grammatical position: the response to an implied oath.
The clause «زعمتم ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «لن نجعل ...» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of أن — the lightened one.
49- (الواو) a conjunction; (وضع) a past verb, passive; (الكتاب) deputy agent, nominative; (الفاء) a conjunction; (ترى) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the sign of the nominative is the implied ḍamma on the alif, and the agent is "you"; (المجرمين) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and the sign of the accusative is the yāʾ; (مشفقين) a ḥāl, accusative, and the sign of the accusative is the yāʾ; (من) a preposition; (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the genitive, attached to (مشفقين); (في) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ما; (الواو) a conjunction; (يقولون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and (الواو) is the agent; (يا) a particle of vocative and lament; (ويلتنا) the one addressed in lament, muḍāf, accusative.. and (نا) is muḍāf ilayhi; (ما) an interrogative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ; (اللام) a preposition and (ها) a particle for drawing attention; (ذا) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of the genitive, attached to the omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ; (الكتاب) badal (substitute) of ذا — or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) — genitive; (لا) negative; (يغادر) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the agent is "it" (هو); (صغيرة) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (الواو) a conjunction; (كبيرة) conjoined to صغيرة, accusative, and (لا) is redundant, to emphasize the negation; (إلّا) for restriction; (أحصاها) a past verb, indeclinable on the implied fatḥa..
and (ها) is a pronoun, direct object, and the agent is "it", i.e. the Book; (الواو) circumstantial; (وجدوا) a past verb and its agent; (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle «[Note: Or a relative noun, indeclinable, direct object, with the referent (ʿāʾid) omitted, i.e. "what they did (it)", and the clause is the ṣila.]» (عملوا) like وجدوا; (حاضرا) second direct object, accusative, its governing factor being (وجدوا).
The interpreted maṣdar (ما عملوا..) is in the position of the accusative as first direct object.
(الواو) resumptive; (لا) negative; (يظلم) like يغادر; (ربّك) agent, nominative..
and (الكاف) is muḍāf ilayhi; (أحدا) mafʿūl bihi, accusative.
The clause «وضع الكتاب ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause زعمتم..
The clause «ترى المجرمين ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause وضع الكتاب.
The clause «يقولون ...» is in the position of the accusative, conjoined to the ḥāl (مشفقين).
The clause «of lament ...» (التحسّر) is in the position of the accusative as the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «ما لهذا الكتاب ...» has no grammatical position: the response to the lament.
The clause «لا يغادر ...» is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl of الكتاب.
The clause «أحصاها ...» is in the position of the accusative as an adjective of صغيرة and كبيرة «[Note: Or it is a second direct object of the verb يغادر — meaning يترك (leave) — which is transitive to two objects.]».
The clause «وجدوا ...» is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl of the agent of يقولون, with (قد) implied «[Note: It may be cut off as resumptive, so it would have no grammatical position.]».
The clause «عملوا ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the particle-relative (ما).
The clause «لا يظلم ربّك ...» has no grammatical position: a causal resumption.

* Morphology:
(بارزة): the feminine of بارز, an active participle from the triliteral برز, on the pattern فاعل.
(صفّا): an aurally transmitted (samāʿī) maṣdar of the triliteral verb صفّ; its pattern is فعل with fatḥa then sukūn.
(مشفقين): the plural of مشفق, an active participle from the quadriliteral verb أشفق; pattern مفعل with ḍamma on the mīm and kasra on the ʿayn.
(حاضرا): an active participle from the triliteral حضر; its pattern is فاعل.

* Rhetoric:
1- The art of combination (al-jamʿ) in the saying of Allah the Exalted «الْمالُ وَالْبَنُونَ زِينَةُ الْحَياةِ الدُّنْيا».
This art is: that the speaker combines two or more things in a single judgement, and this is clear in the noble verse, where He combined wealth and sons in a single judgement, namely the adornment of the life of this world.
2- The imaginative implicit metaphor (al-istiʿāra al-makniyya al-takhyīliyya):
In the saying of Allah the Exalted: «يا وَيْلَتَنا».
It is a calling upon their own destruction, by which they were destroyed, singled out from among destructions; for الويلة, like الويل, is destruction, and calling it is on the basis of likening it to a person whose approach is sought, as if it were said: "O destruction, come, for this is your time."
3- Using the general in negation and the specific in affirmation:
In the saying of Allah the Exalted «مالِ هذَا الْكِتابِ لا يُغادِرُ صَغِيرَةً وَلا كَبِيرَةً إِلَّا أَحْصاها».
For the existence of accountability for the small sin entails the existence of accountability for the great one; so the apparent expression would have been "it leaves out no great and no small", based on what they said, that ascending in affirmation goes from the lower to the higher, and in negation the reverse, since doing the lower does not entail doing the higher, unlike in negation. But the verifying scholars said: this applies when it is taken literally; if it is a metonymy for generality, as here — and as in your saying "he gave me neither little nor much" — it is permissible to put the lower before the higher in negation.

safi-cedvel:50-50.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (إذ) an adverbial noun in the position of the accusative as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "اذكر"; (قلنا) a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); (للملائكة) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (قلنا); (اسجدوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn.. and (الواو) is the agent; (لآدم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (اسجدوا), and the sign of the genitive is the fatḥa; (الفاء) a conjunction; (سجدوا) a past verb and agent; (إلّا) a particle of exception; (إبليس) excepted (mustathnā), accusative (manṣūb) «[Note: As a disconnected or connected exception, depending on Iblīs's relation to the angels and their two kinds.]», (كان) an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb — an abrogator (nāsikh) — and its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو"; (من الجنّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar (predicate) of kāna; (الفاء) a conjunction; (فسق) a past verb, and the agent is "he" (هو); (عن أمر) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (فسق), by making it imply the meaning of "departed from obedience"; (ربّه) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr), and (الهاء) is muḍāf ilayhi; (الهمزة) for the rebuking, disapproving interrogative; (الفاء) resumptive — or a conjunction; (تتّخذون) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ)..
and (الواو) is the agent, and (الهاء) is a pronoun, direct object; (الواو) a conjunction; (ذرّيّته) conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the third-person object pronoun.. and (الهاء) is muḍāf ilayhi; (أولياء) second direct object, accusative; (من دوني) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an adjective of أولياء; (الواو) circumstantial (ḥāliyya); (هم) a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (اللام) a preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of (عدوّ) «[Note: Or attached to عدوّ.]», which is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, nominative; (بئس) a frozen (jāmid) past verb for expressing blame, and the agent is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو"; (للظالمين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl of (بدلا) «[Note: Or attached to (بدلا).]», which is a tamyīz (specification) of the agent pronoun, accusative, and the one specified for blame is omitted, its implied form being "هو", i.e. Iblīs.
The clause «(اذكر) إذ قلنا ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive. The clause «قلنا ...» is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. The clause «اسجدوا ...» is in the position of the accusative as the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «سجدوا ...» is in the position of the genitive, conjoined to the clause قلنا. The clause «كان من الجنّ ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī). The clause «فسق ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause كان من الجنّ. The clause «تتّخذونه ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive «[Note: Or conjoined to an implied resumption, i.e. "Do you disbelieve and so take him..".]». The clause «وهم لكم عدوّ ...» is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl. The clause «بئس للظالمين ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.

* Morphology:
(بدلا): the noun from بدل يبدل, of the bāb of نصر; it is compensation or replacement, in the sense of substitute; its pattern is فعل with two fatḥas.

safi-cedvel:19-20.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (الكاف) a preposition [Note: or a noun meaning "like" (مثل), in the position of accusative as a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar, governed by بعثناهم.]; (ذلك) a demonstrative in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq governed by بعثناهم, and (اللام) is for distance and (الكاف) for address; (بعثناهم) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, and (نا) a pronoun, fāʿil (agent), and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (اللام) the lām of cause (taʿlīl) [Note: or of outcome (ṣayrūra).]; (يتساءلوا) an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an «أن» concealed after the lām, the sign of the accusative being the dropping of the nūn... and (الواو) is the fāʿil; (بينهم) an adverb, accusative, attached to (يتساءلوا)... and (هم) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (قال) a past verb; (قائل) fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ); (من) a preposition, and (هم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to a naʿt (adjective) of قائل; (كم) an interrogative noun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as an adverb of time, and its tamyīz (specification) is implied (muqaddar), i.e. "how many days"; (لبثتم) like بعثنا; (قالوا) a past verb and its fāʿil; (لبثنا) like بعثنا; (يوما) an adverb of time, accusative, attached to (لبثنا); (أو) a conjunction; (بعض) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to (يوما), accusative; (يوم) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr).
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يتساءلوا..) is in the position of genitive by the lām, attached to (بعثناهم).
(قالوا) like the first; (ربّكم أعلم) like «ربّنا ربّ» [Note: in verse (14) of this sūra.]; (الباء) a preposition; (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle; (لبثتم) like بعثنا.
The interpreted maṣdar (ما لبثتم) is in the position of genitive by the bāʾ, attached to (أعلم).
(الفاء) a conjunction; (ابعثوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn... and (الواو) is the fāʿil; (أحدكم) mafʿūl bihi, accusative... and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (بورقكم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of أحدكم... and (كم) like the last; (ها) a particle of alerting (tanbīh); (ذه) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of genitive as ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) — or badal (substitute) — of ورقكم; (إلى المدينة) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (ابعثوا); (الفاء) a conjunction; (اللام) the lām of command; (ينظر) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm); the fāʿil is «هو»; (أيّها) a relative noun, indeclinable on ḍamma, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi [Note: or it is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative, whose khabar (predicate) is (أزكى), the nominal clause being governed by the verb ينظر, which is suspended by the interrogative, with the preposition (إلى) omitted...]; (ها) a pronoun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; (أزكى) the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being «هو», nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied on the alif; (طعاما) tamyīz, accusative; (الفاء) a conjunction; (ليأتكم) like لينظر, the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the weak letter... and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (برزق) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يأتكم) [Note: or attached to an omitted ḥāl of the fāʿil of يأتكم.]; (منه) like منهم, attached to a naʿt of (رزق); (الواو) a conjunction; (ليتلطّف) like لينظر; (الواو) a conjunction; (لا) the jussive lā of prohibition; (يشعرنّ) an imperfect verb, indeclinable on fatḥa, in the position of jussive... and (النون) is the nūn of emphasis; the fāʿil is «هو»; (الباء) a preposition, and (كم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (يشعرنّ); (أحدا) mafʿūl bihi, accusative.
The clause «بعثناهم ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «يتساءلوا ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the concealed particle-relative (al-mawṣūl al-ḥarfī) (أن).
The clause «قال قائل ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «كم لبثتم ...» is in the position of accusative as the speech reported by the verb of saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «قالوا ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption.
The clause «لبثنا ...» is in the position of accusative as maqūl al-qawl.
The clause «قالوا.. (the second)» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «ربّكم أعلم ...» is in the position of accusative as maqūl al-qawl.
The clause «لبثتم ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the particle-relative (ما).
The clause «ابعثوا ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to an implied resumptive clause, i.e. "attend to the matter of your food, and send...".
The clause «لينظر ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause ابعثوا.
The clause «(هو) أزكى ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (أيّها).
The clause «ليأتكم ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause لينظر.
The clause «ليتلطّف ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause لينظر.
The clause «يشعرنّ ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause ليتلطّف.
20- (إنّهم) a particle resembling the verb... and (هم) a pronoun in the position of accusative as the noun of إنّ; (إن) a jussive conditional particle; (يظهروا) an imperfect verb, jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn... and (الواو) is the fāʿil; (على) a preposition, and (كم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (يظهروا); (يرجموكم) like يظهروا, the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ)... and (كم) mafʿūl bihi; (أو) a conjunction; (يعيدوكم) like يرجموكم and conjoined to it; (في ملّتهم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl of the object pronoun [Note: it has been said that the verb يعيدوكم here takes two objects, because it means "they will make you be in their creed", so the preposition phrase is attached to a second object.]... and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) a conjunction; (لن) a particle of negation and of the subjunctive; (تفلحوا) an imperfect verb, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the dropping of the nūn... and (الواو) is the fāʿil; (إذا) — with nunation — a particle of response with no governing effect; (أبدا) an adverb of time, accusative, attached to (تفلحوا).
The clause «إنّهم ...» has no grammatical position: causal (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «إن يظهروا ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of إنّ [Note: the khabar may be the two clauses of condition and apodosis together.].
The clause «يرجموكم ...» has no grammatical position: an apodosis not joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «يعيدوكم ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the apodosis clause.
The clause «لن تفلحوا ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the apodosis clause.

* Morphology:
(ورقكم): a non-derived (jāmid) noun meaning "minted silver"; its wazn is فعل with fatḥa then kasra.

* Benefits:
- «كَمْ لَبِثْتُمْ»:
We have already discussed the interrogative and the declarative كم. This كم is the interrogative one.
It is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi, because the verb after it is transitive and has not yet taken its object; and the tamyīz of «كم» is omitted, its implied form being «كم يوما لبثتم», as evidenced by the answer coming as «يَوْماً أَوْ بَعْضَ يَوْمٍ». [Translator's note: so in the source; the i'rab above parses كم as an adverb of time, and لبث is intransitive.]

safi-cedvel:21-21.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (كذلك أعثرنا) like «كذلك بعثنا» «1»; (على) a preposition, and (هم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أعثرنا); (ليعلموا) like «ليتساءلوا» «2» [Translator's note: the markers «1» and «2» are printed in the source without corresponding footnotes; they presumably refer to verse 19.]; (أنّ) a particle resembling the verb; (وعد) the noun of أنّ, accusative (manṣūb); (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr); (حقّ) khabar (predicate), nominative (marfūʿ); (الواو) a conjunction; (أنّ الساعة) like «أنّ وعد»; (لا) the lā of generic negation; (ريب) the noun of لا, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of accusative; (في) a preposition, and (ها) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to the khabar of لا; (إذ) an adverb of past time, indeclinable, in the position of accusative, attached to (أعثرنا) [Note: or attached to (يعلموا).]; (يتنازعون) an imperfect verb, nominative...
and (الواو) is the fāʿil (agent); (بينهم) an adverb, accusative, attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of أمرهم... and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (أمرهم) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative... and (هم) like the last.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يعلموا..) is in the position of genitive by the lām, attached to (أعثرنا).
The interpreted maṣdar (أنّ وعد الله حقّ) is in the position of accusative, standing in for the two objects of يعلموا.
The interpreted maṣdar (أنّ الساعة..) is in the position of genitive, conjoined to the interpreted maṣdar «أنّ وعد..». [Translator's note: so in the source, although the maṣdar it is conjoined to was just said to be in the position of accusative.]
(الفاء) a conjunction; (قالوا) a past verb and its fāʿil, namely the disbelievers; (ابنوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn... and (الواو) is the fāʿil; (عليهم) like the first, attached to (ابنوا); (بنيانا) mafʿūl bihi, accusative [Note: or a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), since it may be a maṣdar, with the mafʿūl bihi implied.]; (ربّهم أعلم) «ربّنا ربّ» [Note: in verse (21) of this sūra. [Translator's note: so in the source; the reference is evidently to verse (14).]; (بهم) like عليهم, attached to (أعلم); (قال) a past verb; (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as fāʿil; (غلبوا) like قالوا; (على أمرهم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (غلبوا)... and (هم) muḍāf ilayhi; (اللام) the lām of the oath, for an implied oath; (نتّخذنّ) an imperfect verb, indeclinable on fatḥa, in the position of nominative... and (النون) is for emphasis; the fāʿil is «نحن»; (عليهم) like the first, attached to an omitted second mafʿūl bihi [Note: or attached to (نتّخذنّ) by making it carry the sense of «نقيمنّ» ("we shall surely erect")... and in (عليهم) there is an omitted muḍāf, i.e. "over their cave".]; (مسجدا) mafʿūl bihi.
The clause «أعثرنا ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «يعلموا ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the concealed particle-relative (al-mawṣūl al-ḥarfī) (أن).
The clause «لا ريب فيها ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of (the second) أنّ.
The clause «يتنازعون ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «قالوا ...» is in the position of genitive, conjoined to the clause يتنازعون.
The clause «ابنوا ...» is in the position of accusative as the speech reported by the verb of saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «ربّهم أعلم ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī) — or causal (taʿlīliyya) — [Note: it is included within their speech... If, however, it is the speech of Allah the Exalted outside the context of their words, it is parenthetical.].
The clause «قال الذين ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «غلبوا ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «نتّخذنّ ...» has no grammatical position: the response to the implied oath... and the implied oath clause is in the position of accusative as maqūl al-qawl.

* Rhetoric:
- The implied metaphor (al-istiʿāra al-makniyya) in the words of the Exalted «يَتَنازَعُونَ بَيْنَهُمْ أَمْرَهُمْ».
In the speech there is an implied metaphor, since their affair is likened to a thing over which there is much contention; then that thing is omitted, and the contention taking place over it is borrowed.

safi-cedvel:51-51.t:
* I'rab:
(ما) negative; (أشهدتهم) a past verb and its fāʿil (agent).. and (هم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (خلق) second direct object, accusative (manṣūb); (السموات) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr); (الأرض) conjoined (maʿṭūf) to السموات by the wāw, genitive; (الواو) a conjunction; (لا) redundant (zāʾida) to emphasize the negation; (خلق) conjoined to the first خلق, accusative; (أنفسهم) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive.. and (هم) is muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) a conjunction; (ما) like the first; (كنت) an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb.. and (التاء) is its noun; (متّخذ) the khabar (predicate) of kuntu, accusative; (المضلّين) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, and the sign of the genitive is the yāʾ; (عضدا) second direct object of the active participle متّخذ, and its first object came as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «ما أشهدتهم ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive. The clause «ما كنت متّخذ ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the resumptive clause.

* Morphology:
(المضلّين): the plural of المضلّ, an active participle from the quadriliteral أضلّ; its pattern is مفعل with ḍamma on the mīm and kasra on the ʿayn. (عضدا): a primitive (jāmid) noun for the well-known limb, taken as a description by way of metaphor; its pattern is فعل with fatḥa on the fāʾ and ḍamma on the ʿayn.

* Rhetoric:
- The eloquent simile (tashbīh balīgh):
In the saying of Allah the Exalted «وَما كُنْتُ مُتَّخِذَ الْمُضِلِّينَ عَضُداً».
He likened those who lead astray to the upper arm (ʿaḍud), by which a person is strengthened — its original meaning is the limb from the elbow to the shoulder — and did not mention the particle of comparison, so it is an eloquent simile.

* Benefits:
1- Wealth and sons.
Allah described «الْمالُ وَالْبَنُونَ» as the adornment of the life of this world, and they will remain its adornment as long as this world lasts and as long as life lasts. This kind of rhetoric is called «the art of combination» (fann al-jamʿ), in which the speaker combines several things and then predicates of them a single predicate. Among it is
the ḥadīth of the Messenger ﷺ: «Whoever wakes up secure in his dwelling, healthy in his body, having his day's sustenance, it is as though the world in its entirety had been gathered for him.»
And among it is the saying of Abū al-ʿAtāhiya:
ان الشباب والفراغ والجدة ... مفسدة للمرء أيّ مفسدة
(Youth, leisure and wealth are a corruption for a man — and what a corruption!)

safi-cedvel:52-52.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (يوم) mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "اذكر"; (يقول) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the fāʿil (agent) is "He" (هو), i.e. Allah; (نادوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn.. and (الواو) is the agent; (شركائي) mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb), and the sign of the accusative is the implied fatḥa on the letter before the yāʾ.. and (الياء) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (الذين) a relative noun in the position of the accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of شركاء; (زعمتم) a past verb and its agent, and the two objects have been omitted, i.e. "you claimed them to be partners"; (الفاء) a conjunction; (دعوهم) a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma implied on the alif that was dropped because of the meeting of two quiescent letters.. and (الواو) is the agent, and (هم) is a pronoun, direct object; (الفاء) a conjunction; (لم) a particle of negation that makes jussive; (يستجيبوا) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), and the sign of the jussive is the dropping of the nūn.. and (الواو) is the agent; (اللام) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يستجيبوا); (الواو) circumstantial (ḥāliyya); (جعلنا) a past verb and its agent; (بينهم) an adverb, accusative, attached to a second direct object.. and (هم) is muḍāf ilayhi; (موبقا) first direct object, accusative.
The clause «يقول ...» is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. The clause «نادوا ...» is in the position of the accusative as the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl). The clause «زعمتم ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين). The clause «دعوهم ...» is in the position of the genitive, conjoined to the clause يقول. The clause «لم يستجيبوا ...» is in the position of the genitive, conjoined to the clause دعوهم. The clause «جعلنا ...» is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), with (قد) implied.

* Morphology:
(دعوهم): it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion; its origin is دعاوهم; when two quiescent letters met, the alif was deleted and the letter before it remained with fatḥa to indicate it; its pattern is فعوهم.
(موبقا): a mīm-maṣdar (maṣdar mīmī) from the triliteral وبق, which is weak in its first radical (muʿtall mithāl), meaning "to perish"; or it is a noun of place from the same verb; its pattern is مفعل with fatḥa on the mīm and kasra on the ʿayn. It was said it is a valley in Hell or the Fire, and it was said it is the barrier.

safi-cedvel:53-53.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (رأى) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the implied fatḥa; (المجرمون) fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ), and the sign of the nominative is the wāw; (النار) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (الفاء) a conjunction; (ظنّوا) a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma.. and (الواو) is the agent; (أنّهم) a particle resembling the verb, and (هم) an attached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative [as the noun of] anna «[Translator's note: the source reads "في محلّ نصب أنّ", evidently "the noun of anna" (اسم أنّ).]»; (مواقعوها) the khabar (predicate) of anna, nominative, and the sign of the nominative is the wāw.. and (ها) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The interpreted maṣdar (أنّهم مواقعوها..) is in the position of the accusative, standing in place of the two objects of ظنّوا..
(الواو) a conjunction; (لم) a particle of negation that makes jussive; (يجدوا) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), and the sign of the jussive is the dropping of the nūn.. and (الواو) is the agent; (عن) a preposition and (ها) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted second direct object; (مصرفا) first direct object, accusative.
The clause «رأى المجرمون ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive. The clause «ظنّوا ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the resumptive clause. The clause «لم يجدوا ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause ظنّوا ...

* Morphology:
(مواقعوها): the plural of مواقع, an active participle from the quadriliteral واقع; its pattern is مفاعل with ḍamma on the mīm and kasra on the ʿayn. (مصرفا): a noun of place from the triliteral verb صرف; its pattern is مفعل with fatḥa on the mīm and kasra on the ʿayn.

safi-cedvel:54-54.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (اللام) the lām of the oath, for an implied oath; (قد) a particle of verification; (صرّفنا) a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); (في) a preposition; (ها) a particle for drawing attention; (ذا) a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (صرّفنا); (القرآن) badal (substitute) of ذا — or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) — genitive (majrūr); (للناس) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (صرّفنا); (من كلّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (صرّفنا) «[Note: And (من) is for the beginning of the extent.. It may be attached to an adjective of the omitted object, i.e. "a parable of the kind of every parable".]», (مثل) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive; (الواو) a conjunction; (كان) an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb; (الإنسان) the noun of kāna, nominative (marfūʿ); (أكثر) the khabar (predicate) of kāna, accusative (manṣūb); (شيء) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (جدلا) tamyīz (specification), accusative.
The clause «صرّفنا ...» has no grammatical position: the response to an implied oath.. and the oath clause is resumptive. The clause «كان الإنسان ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause of the response to the oath «[Note: It may be cut off as resumptive..]».

* Morphology:
(جدلا): an aurally transmitted (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb جدل يجدل الرجل, of the bāb of فرح, i.e. his contentiousness became intense; its pattern is فعل with two fatḥas.

safi-cedvel:55-56.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (ما) negative; (منع) a past verb; (الناس) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (أن) a maṣdar-forming particle; (يؤمنوا) an imperfect verb, accusative, and the sign of the accusative is the dropping of the nūn.. and (الواو) is the fāʿil (agent).
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يؤمنوا..) is in the position of the accusative as second direct object.
(إذ) an adverb of past time, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (منع); (جاءهم) a past verb.. and (هم) is a pronoun, direct object; (الهدى) agent, nominative (marfūʿ), and the sign of the nominative is the implied ḍamma on the alif; (الواو) a conjunction; (يستغفروا) like يؤمنوا, and conjoined to it; (ربّهم) mafʿūl bihi, accusative.. and (هم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (إلّا) a particle of restriction; (أن) like the first; (تأتيهم) an imperfect verb, accusative.. and (هم) is a pronoun, direct object; (سنّة) agent, nominative; (الأوّلين) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr), and the sign of the genitive is the yāʾ; (أو) a conjunction; (يأتيهم العذاب) like تأتيهم سنّة, and conjoined to it; (قبلا) a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative, of العذاب.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تأتيهم..) is in the position of the nominative as the agent of منع, with a muḍāf omitted, i.e. "its coming" or "the demand for its coming".
The clause «منع ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive. The clause «يؤمنوا ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle-relative (أن). The clause «جاءهم الهدى ...» is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. The clause «يستغفروا ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause يؤمنوا ...
The clause «تأتيهم سنّة ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the second particle-relative (أن). The clause «يأتيهم العذاب ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause تأتيهم.
56- (الواو) a conjunction; (ما) negative; (نرسل) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the agent is "we" (نحن) for majesty; (المرسلين) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and the sign of the accusative is the yāʾ; (إلّا) a particle of restriction; (مبشّرين) a ḥāl, accusative, and the sign of the accusative is the yāʾ; (منذرين) conjoined (maʿṭūf) to مبشّرين by the wāw..; (الواو) resumptive; (يجادل) an imperfect verb, nominative; (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as agent; (كفروا) a past verb and its agent; (بالباطل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl of the relative; (اللام) for causation (taʿlīl); (يدحضوا) an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after the lām, and the sign of the accusative is the dropping of the nūn.. and (الواو) is the agent; (الباء) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (يدحضوا); (الحقّ) mafʿūl bihi, accusative.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يدحضوا..) is in the position of the genitive by the lām, attached to (يجادل). (الواو) circumstantial (ḥāliyya) — or resumptive; (اتّخذوا) like كفروا; (آياتي) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and the sign of the accusative is the kasra implied on the letter before the yāʾ, and (الياء) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) a conjunction; (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative, conjoined to آيات «[Note: It is permissible that (ما) be a maṣdar-forming particle, and the interpreted maṣdar be in the position of the accusative, conjoined to آيات.]». And the referent (ʿāʾid) is omitted; (أنذروا) a past verb, passive, indeclinable on the ḍamma ... and (الواو) is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); (هزوا) second direct object, its governing factor being اتّخذوا, accusative.
The clause «ما نرسل ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause ما منع. The clause «يجادل ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive. The clause «كفروا ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative (الذين). The clause «يدحضوا ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the implied particle-relative (أن). The clause «اتّخذوا ...» is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl, with (قد) implied «[Note: Or it is resumptive, with no grammatical position.]». The clause «أنذروا ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative (ما).

* Morphology:
(اتّخذوا): it contains assimilation (idghām) of the first radical of the word with the tāʾ of the افتعال pattern; its origin is تخذ; when it was built on افتعل, the first radical was made quiescent because of the connecting hamza, then the two tāʾs were assimilated together «[Note: This is the view of the majority, contrary to al-Jawharī. It is stated in Lisān al-ʿArab: "Ibn al-Athīr said: اتّخذ is افتعل from تخذ, so one of the two tāʾs was assimilated into the other. He said: it has nothing to do with أخذ; the افتعال of أخذ is ائتخذ, because its first radical is a hamza and the hamza is not assimilated into the tāʾ. Al-Jawharī said: الاتخاذ is the افتعال of الأخذ, except that it was assimilated after softening the hamza and substituting the tāʾ; then, when its use in the افتعال form became frequent, they imagined that the tāʾ was original, so they built from it فعل يفعل, saying تخذ يتخذ. He said: the scholars of Arabic hold the opposite of what al-Jawharī said."]».

safi-cedvel:57-57.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (من) an interrogative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (أظلم) khabar (predicate), nominative (marfūʿ); (من) a preposition; (من) a relative noun in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أظلم); (ذكّر) a past verb, passive, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is "he" (هو), and it is the referent (ʿāʾid); (بآيات) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (ذكّر); (ربّه) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr), and (الهاء) is muḍāf ilayhi; (الفاء) a conjunction; (أعرض) a past verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is "he"; (عن) a preposition and (ها) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (أعرض); (الواو) a conjunction; (نسي) like أعرض; (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (قدّمت) a past verb, and (التاء) is for the feminine; (يداه) agent, nominative, and the sign of the nominative is the alif.. and (الهاء) is muḍāf ilayhi; (انّا) a particle resembling the verb.. and (نا) a pronoun in the position of the accusative as the noun of inna; (جعلنا) a past verb and its agent; (على قلوبهم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted second direct object..
and (هم) is muḍāf ilayhi; (أكنّة) first direct object, accusative (manṣūb); (أن) a maṣdar-forming particle; (يفقهوه) an imperfect verb, accusative, and the sign of the accusative is the dropping of the nūn ... and (الواو) is the agent, and (الهاء) is the direct object.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يفقهوه ...) is in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), with a muḍāf omitted, i.e. "out of aversion that they should understand it"..
(الواو) a conjunction; (في آذانهم وقرا) like على قلوبهم أكنّة, and conjoined to it «[Note: It is permissible that there be an omitted verb there, its implied form being "جعلنا", in which case the conjunction is a conjoining of clauses.]», (الواو) a conjunction; (إن) a conditional particle making jussive; (تدعهم) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the sign of the jussive is the dropping of the weak letter.. and (هم) is a pronoun, direct object; (إلى الهدى) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تدعهم), and the sign of the genitive is the implied kasra; (الفاء) linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (لن) a particle of negation that makes accusative; (يهتدوا) an imperfect verb, accusative, like يفقهوا; (إذا) — with nunation — a particle of response with no governing effect; (أبدا) an adverb, accusative, attached to (يهتدوا).
The clause «من أظلم ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive. The clause «ذكّر ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (من). The clause «أعرض ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the ṣila clause. The clause «نسي ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the ṣila clause. The clause «نسي ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the ṣila clause «[Translator's note: this sentence is repeated in the source.]». The clause «قدّمت يداه ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative (ما). The clause «إنّا جعلنا ...» has no grammatical position: a justification of what preceded. The clause «جعلنا ...» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of inna. The clause «تدعهم ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause إنّا جعلنا «[Note: Or resumptive, without justification.]». The clause «لن يهتدوا ...» is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis of a jussive condition, joined with the fāʾ.

safi-cedvel:58-59.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (ربّك) mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ).. and (الكاف) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (الغفور) khabar (predicate), nominative «[Note: Or an adjective of ربّك.. and the clause يؤاخذهم is the khabar.]», (ذو) second khabar, nominative, and the sign of the nominative is the wāw; (الرحمة) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr); (لو) a non-jussive conditional particle; (يؤاخذهم) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and (هم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil (agent) is "He" (هو); (الباء) a preposition of causation; (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle «[Note: Or a relative noun in the position of the genitive by the bāʾ, with the referent omitted, i.e. "what they earned (it)".]», (كسبوا) a past verb and its agent; (اللام) linking the apodosis of law; (عجّل) a past verb, and the agent is "He"; (اللام) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (عجّل); (العذاب) mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb).
The interpreted maṣdar (ما كسبوا ...) is in the position of the genitive by the bāʾ, attached to (يؤاخذهم).
(بل) a particle of digression (iḍrāb) and of beginning; (لهم) like the first, attached to a fronted khabar; (موعد) a delayed mubtadaʾ, nominative; (لن يجدوا) like لن يهتدوا «[Note: In the previous verse (57).]», (من دونه) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of (موئلا) «[Note: Or attached to an omitted second direct object, if you make (يجدوا) transitive to two objects.]», and (الهاء) is muḍāf ilayhi; (موئلا) mafʿūl bihi.
The clause «ربّك الغفور ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive. The clause «يؤاخذهم ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive «[Note: It may be a third khabar of the mubtadaʾ ربّك.]». The clause «كسبوا ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle-relative (ما). The clause «عجّل ...» has no grammatical position: the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. The clause «لهم موعد ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive. The clause «لن يجدوا ...» is in the position of the nominative as a naʿt (adjective) of موعد.
59- (الواو) a conjunction; (تلك) a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn that is overt on the yāʾ dropped because of the meeting of two quiescent letters, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ.. and (اللام) is for distance and (الكاف) for address; (القرى) badal (substitute) of the demonstrative — or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) — nominative, and the sign of the nominative is the implied ḍamma on the alif; (أهلكناهم) a past verb and its agent.. and (هم) is a pronoun, direct object; (لمّا) an adverb meaning "when", containing a conditional meaning, attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being "أهلكناهم", which is the apodosis; (ظلموا) like كسبوا; (الواو) a conjunction; (جعلنا لمهلكهم موعدا) like جعلنا على قلوبهم أكنّة «[Note: In verse (57) of this sūra.]».
The clause «تلك القرى أهلكناهم ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause ربّك الغفور..
The clause «أهلكناهم ...» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (تلك). The clause «ظلموا ...» is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.. and the apodosis clause is implied, i.e. "We destroyed them". The clause «جعلنا ...» is in the position of the nominative, conjoined to the clause أهلكناهم.

* Morphology:
(موئلا): a mīm-maṣdar (maṣdar mīmī) from the triliteral verb وأل, meaning "to return", of the bāb of ضرب.. or it is a noun of time or a noun of place; its pattern is مفعل with fatḥa on the mīm and kasra on the ʿayn. (مهلك): a mīm-maṣdar from the triliteral verb هلك, of the bāb of ضرب and the bāb of فتح; its pattern is مفعل with fatḥa on the mīm and kasra on the ʿayn.

* Benefits:
- The rule of the elative (ism al-tafḍīl): a- If it is joined with «ال», it may not be connected with the preposition «من», so one does not say: «فلان الأفضل من فلان».
b- If it is stripped of «ال» and annexation, it must be singular and masculine, and the preposition «من» must be connected to it, even if implied, as in «وَالْآخِرَةُ خَيْرٌ وَأَبْقى»..
c- If it is annexed to an indefinite noun, it must be singular and masculine, and it may not be connected with the preposition «من».
d- If it is annexed to a definite noun, it likewise may not be connected with the preposition من, and two ways are permissible in it:
being singular and masculine on the one hand, and agreeing with what precedes it on the other, as in «أَحْرَصَ النَّاسِ» in the singular, and «أَكابِرَ مُجْرِمِيها» in the plural, i.e. agreement and non-agreement..!

safi-cedvel:60-62.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (قال) a past verb, whose fāʿil (agent) is (موسى), nominative (marfūʿ), and the sign of the nominative is the implied ḍamma; and (إذ) is an adverbial noun in the position of the accusative as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "اذكر"; (لفتاه) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (قال), and the sign of the genitive is the implied kasra on the alif, and (الهاء) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (لا) negative; (أبرح) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the agent is "I" (أنا) «[Note: And (أبرح) means "I leave" or "I depart", so it needs an object, which is implied: "I will not leave off my journey — or my mission — until I reach".. It is permissible that the verb be incomplete (nāqiṣ), its khabar (predicate) omitted, its implied form being "travelling".. And al-ʿUkbarī permits the khabar to be (حتّى أبلغ) by a forced interpretation.]», (حتّى) a particle of limit and a preposition; (أبلغ) an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after حتّى, and the agent is "I"; (مجمع) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (البحرين) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr), and the sign of the genitive is the yāʾ; (أو) a conjunction; (أمضي) an imperfect verb, accusative, conjoined to (أبلغ), and it is like it «[Note: It may be accusative by an implied أن after أو in the sense of (إلّا), i.e. "unless I go on for a time with which I become certain of having missed the meeting of the two seas".]», (حقبا) an adverb of time, accusative, attached to (أمضي) «[Translator's note: the source prints "متعلّق و (أمضي)", with و for ب.]».
The interpreted maṣdar (أن أبلغ) is in the position of the genitive by (حتّى), attached to (أبرح).
The clause «قال موسى ...» is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. The clause «لا أبرح ...» is in the position of the accusative as the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl). The clause «أبلغ ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle-relative (أن). The clause «أمضي ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the ṣila clause of the particle-relative.
61- (الفاء) a conjunction; (لمّا) an adverb meaning "when", containing a conditional meaning, attached to (نسيا); (بلغا) a past verb, and (الألف) is an attached pronoun in the position of the nominative as agent; (مجمع) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (بين) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive «[Note: And البين means joining, and also separation, so it is one of the words with opposite meanings (aḍdād); it may be a declinable adverb to which the word مجمع is annexed.]», and (هما) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (نسيا) like بلغا; (حوتهما) mafʿūl bihi, accusative.. and (هما) is like the first; (الفاء) a conjunction; (اتّخذ) a past verb, and the agent is "it" (هو), i.e. the fish; (سبيله) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and (الهاء) is muḍāf ilayhi; (في البحر) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of سبيل — or of سربا; (سربا) second direct object, accusative.
The clause «بلغا ...» is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. The clause «نسيا ...» has no grammatical position: the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. The clause «اتّخذ ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the apodosis clause.
62- (الفاء) a conjunction; (لمّا جاوزا قال) like لمّا بلغا.. نسيا; (لفتاه) like the first; (آتنا) an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the weak letter.. and (نا) is a pronoun, direct object; (غداءنا) second direct object, accusative, and (نا) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (اللام) the lām of the oath, for an implied oath; (قد) a particle of verification; (لقينا) a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn.. and (نا) is a pronoun, agent; (من سفرنا) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (لقينا), and (نا) is muḍāf ilayhi; (ها) a particle for drawing attention; (ذا) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of the genitive as badal (substitute) of سفرنا — or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition); (نصبا) tamyīz (specification), accusative.
The clause «جاوزا ...» is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position: the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. The clause «آتنا ...» is in the position of the accusative as the object of saying. The clause «لقينا ...» has no grammatical position: the response to an implied oath, and the oath with its response is a causal resumption.

* Morphology:
(مجمع): a noun of place from the triliteral جمع, on the pattern مفعل with fatḥa on the mīm and the ʿayn. (حقبا): a noun meaning a long age; its plural is أحقاب; its pattern is فعل with two ḍammas, and the pattern of the plural is أفعال; the ḍamma of the ʿayn here is for vowel harmony (itbāʿ), a dialectal usage, and it may be given fatḥa.
(غداء): a noun for food taken in the morning (الغدد) «[Translator's note: so in the source; presumably الغداة, "the morning", is meant.]»; its pattern is فعال with fatḥa on the fāʾ, and it contains substitution (ibdāl) of the final wāw by a hamza after the quiescent alif.

safi-cedvel:63-63.t:
* I'rab:
(قال) a past verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is "he" (هو), i.e. the young man; (الهمزة) for the interrogative of wonder; (رأيت) a past verb and its agent, and the object is omitted, i.e. "did you see our situation"; (إذ) an adverb, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted [object] or to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of it; (أوينا) like لقينا «[Note: In the previous verse (62).]», (الى الصخرة) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أوينا); (الفاء) resumptive; (إنّي) a particle resembling the verb.. and (الياء) is a pronoun, the noun of inna; (نسيت) like رأيت; (الحوت) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (الواو) parenthetical (iʿtirāḍiyya); (ما) negative; (إنسانية) «[Translator's note: so printed in the source; the Quranic word is أنسانيه.]» a past verb, indeclinable on the implied fatḥa, and (النون) is for protection (wiqāya), and (الياء) is a pronoun, first direct object, and (الهاء) the second direct object; (إلّا) a particle of restriction; (الشيطان) agent, nominative (marfūʿ); (أن) a maṣdar-forming particle that makes accusative; (أذكره) an imperfect verb, accusative, and (الهاء) is the direct object, and the agent is "I" (أنا).
The interpreted maṣdar (أن أذكره..) is in the position of the accusative as a badal (substitute) of inclusion (badal ishtimāl) of the hāʾ in أنسانيه.
(الواو) a conjunction; (اتّخذ.. عجبا) like اتّخذ.. سربا «[Note: In verse (61) of this sūra.. And in (عجبا) it is also permissible that it be a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb.. on this view the second object is the preposition and its genitive noun (في البحر).]».
The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī). The clause «أرأيت ...» is in the position of the accusative as the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl). The clause «أوينا ...» is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The clause «إنّي نسيت ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive. The clause «نسيت ...» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of inna. The clause «ما أنسانيه إلّا الشيطان ...» has no grammatical position: parenthetical. The clause «أذكره ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle-relative (أن). The clause «اتّخذ ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause إنّي نسيت.

safi-cedvel:64-65.t:
* I'rab:
(قال) a past verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is "he" (هو), i.e. Moses; (ذلك) a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), and (اللام) is for distance and (الكاف) for address; (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate); (كنّا) an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb and its noun; (نبغي) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the sign of the nominative is the ḍamma implied on the yāʾ, which is dropped from the script for lightness, and the agent is "we" (نحن); (الفاء) a conjunction; (ارتدّا) like بلغا «[Note: In verse (61) of this sūra.]», (على آثارهما) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (ارتدّا), and (هما) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (قصصا) mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb «[Note: Or a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the place of a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "retracing".]», accusative (manṣūb). The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive. The clause «ذلك ما كنّا ...» is in the position of the accusative as the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl). The clause «كنّا نبغي ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (ما). The clause «نبغي ...» is in the position of the accusative as the khabar of kunnā.
The clause «ارتدّا ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the resumptive clause.
65- (الفاء) a conjunction; (وجدا) like بلغا «[Note: In verse (61) of this sūra.]», (عبدا) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative; (من عبادنا) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an adjective of (عبدا), and (نا) is muḍāf ilayhi; (آتيناه) a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn.. and (نا) is the agent, and (الهاء) is a pronoun, direct object; (رحمة) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (من عندنا) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an adjective of رحمة «[Note: Or attached to (اتيناه).]», and (نا) is like the first; (الواو) a conjunction; (علّمناه) like آتيناه; (من لدنّا) a preposition and its genitive noun, the noun being in the position of the genitive, attached to (علّمناه) «[Note: Or attached to an omitted ḥāl of (علما).]». And (نا) is like the first; (علما) second direct object, accusative.
The clause «وجدا ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause ارتدّا. The clause «آتيناه ...» is in the position of the accusative as an adjective of (عبدا) «[Note: Or it is a ḥāl of (عبدا), because it is qualified.]». The clause «علّمناه ...» is in the position of the accusative, conjoined to the clause آتيناه..

* Morphology:
(قصصا): an aurally transmitted (samāʿī) maṣdar of the triliteral قصّ الأثر, meaning to follow it step by step; its pattern is فعل with two fatḥas.

* Benefits:
1- لدن:
a- In all its dialectal forms and divisions it is for the starting point of a time or a place, and it is like «عند» in its meaning and its annexation. It puts what follows it in the genitive by annexation, in form if it is declinable, and in position if it is indeclinable or a clause. The first, as in «مِنْ لَدُنْ حَكِيمٍ خَبِيرٍ»; the second, as in «وَعَلَّمْناهُ مِنْ لَدُنَّا عِلْماً»; and the third is the clause, as in «لدن شبّ حتى شاب سود الذوائب» (from when he grew young until the black locks turned grey).
So «لدن» is always annexed; if it is annexed to a clause it becomes purely temporal, because no adverb of place is annexed to a clause except «حيث».
If the yāʾ of the speaker is attached to «لدن», the nūn of protection is attached to it, so one says: «لدنيّ», with a doubled nūn.
b- «لدن» differs from «عند» in six matters:
1- It is specific to the starting points of extents.
2- The word «من» occurring before it rarely leaves it.
3- It is indeclinable, except in the dialect of Qays.
4- It may be annexed to clauses.
5- It may stand alone before «غدوة», and «غدوة» is made accusative by it — with disagreement over what to call the accusative word — as in the saying: لدن غدوة حتى دنت لغروب (from early morning until it drew near to setting). 6- It occurs only as a non-essential element (faḍla), so you say: السفر من عند دمشق, and not من لدن دمشق.
c- «لدن» differs from «لدى» in five matters:
1- لدن occupies the place of the beginning of an extent, as in «جئت من لدنه». This is not valid with «لدى».
2- «لدن» cannot validly occur as an essential element (ʿumda) of the sentence.
3- «لدن» is frequently put in the genitive by «من», as has passed, unlike «لدى».
4- «لدن» is annexed to a clause, which is impossible with لدى.
5- If «لدن» occurs before «غدوة», it is permissible to put غدوة in the genitive by annexation, in the accusative as tamyīz (specification), and in the nominative on the assumption of «لدن كانت غدوة».
As for «لدى», there is nothing in it but annexation alone.
6- Lightening لدن to «لد»:
لدن may be lightened to «لد» because of frequent use, as in the poet's saying:
من «لد» شولا فإلى اتلائها.
(From when [she was] with milk drying up until her being followed by her young.)
This topic contains curiosities which you will find in the longer works.

safi-cedvel:66-66.t:
* I'rab:
(قال.. موسى) its i'rab has passed «[Note: In verse (60) of this sūra.]», (اللام) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (قال); (هل) an interrogative particle; (أتّبعك) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and (الكاف) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil (agent) is "I" (أنا); (على) a preposition; (أن) a maṣdar-forming particle; (تعلّمن) an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb), and (النون) is for protection (wiqāya), and (الياء), dropped for lightness, is a pronoun, direct object; (من) a preposition; (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the genitive, attached to (تعلّمن); (علّمت) a past verb, passive..
and (التاء) is a pronoun, the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); (رشدا) second direct object, accusative, its governing factor being تعلّمن «[Note: علمت: its object is omitted, and it is the referent (ʿāʾid), i.e. "I was taught it".. It is permissible that it be a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb.. or a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose) whose governing factor is أتّبعك.]».
The interpreted maṣdar in (أن تعلّمن) is in the position of the genitive, attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the kāf, i.e. "persevering in teaching me". The clause «قال له موسى ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive. The clause «هل أتّبعك ...» is in the position of the accusative as the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl). The clause «تعلّمن ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle-relative (أن). The clause «علّمت ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative (ما).

safi-cedvel:67-68.t:
* I'rab:
(قال) a past verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is "he" (هو), i.e. the learned man; (إنّك) a particle resembling the verb — an abrogator (nāsikh) — and (الكاف) a pronoun in the position of the accusative as the noun of inna; (لن) a particle of negation that makes accusative; (تستطيع) an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb), and the agent is "you" (أنت); (معي) an adverb, accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the agent, i.e. "walking with me"; (صبرا) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative.
The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī). The clause «إنّك لن تستطيع ...» is in the position of the accusative as the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl). The clause «تستطيع ...» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of inna.
68- (الواو) a conjunction; (كيف) an interrogative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl; (تصبر) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the agent is "you"; (على) a preposition; (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the genitive «[Note: Or it is a qualified indefinite noun (nakira mawṣūfa), and the clause after it is an adjective in the position of the genitive.]»
attached to (تصبر); (لم) a particle of negation that makes jussive; (تحط) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), and the agent is "you"; (الباء) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (تحط); (خبرا) mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative, standing in for the maṣdar, being synonymous with it «[Note: Because knowing (al-khubr) a thing is encompassing it.]».
The clause «تصبر ...» is in the position of the accusative, conjoined to the clause إنّك لن تستطيع.
The clause «تحط ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (ما).

* Morphology:
(خبرا): an aurally transmitted (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb خبر يخبر الشيء وبه, "he knew its reality", of the bābs of فتح and كرم; its pattern is فعل with ḍamma then sukūn. There are other maṣdars: خبر with kasra on the khāʾ, خبرة with ḍamma or kasra on the khāʾ, and مخبرة with fatḥa on the mīm and ḍamma or fatḥa on the bāʾ.

safi-cedvel:69-69.t:
* I'rab:
(قال) like the previous «[Note: In the previous verse.]»
, (السين) a particle of the future; (تجدني) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ).. and (النون) is for protection (wiqāya), and (الياء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil (agent) is "you" (أنت); (إن) a conditional particle making jussive; (شاء) a past verb in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); (الله) the Majestic Name, agent, nominative; (صابرا) second direct object, accusative (manṣūb); (الواو) a conjunction; (لا) negative; (أعصي) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the sign of the nominative is the implied ḍamma on the yāʾ, and the agent is "I" (أنا); (اللام) a preposition and (الكاف) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أعصي); (أمرا) mafʿūl bihi. The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī). The clause «ستجدني ...» is in the position of the accusative as the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl). The clause «شاء الله ...» has no grammatical position: parenthetical.. and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by the clause تجدني..
The clause «أعصي ...» is in the position of the accusative, conjoined to the second object صابرا, i.e. "patient and not disobedient" «[Note: It may be resumptive within the scope of the saying, with no grammatical position.. or conjoined to the object of saying.]».

safi-cedvel:70-70.t:
* I'rab:
(قال) like the previous «1»
, (الفاء) linking the apodosis of an implied condition; (إن) like the previous «2»
, (اتّبعتني) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and (التاء) is a pronoun, the fāʿil (agent), and (النون) is for protection (wiqāya), and (الياء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (الفاء) linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (لا) prohibitive, making jussive; (تسألني) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), and (النون) is for protection, and (الياء) the direct object, and the agent is "you" (أنت); (عن شيء) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تسألني); (حتّى) a particle of limit and a preposition; (أحدث) an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after حتّى, and the agent is "I" (أنا); (اللام) a preposition and (الكاف) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (أحدث); (منه) like لك, attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of (ذكرا), which is the direct object, accusative.
The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive. The clause «إن اتّبعتني ...» is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e. "if you are resolved on patience"..
The clause «لا تسألني ...» is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ. The clause «أحدث ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the implied particle-relative (أن). And the interpreted maṣdar (أن أحدث) is in the position of the genitive by (حتّى), attached to (تسأل) «[Note: Or attached to an implied verb containing the meaning of لا تسألني, i.e. "be patient until I tell".]»

* Benefits:
- The Messenger narrates about al-Khaḍir:
From Ubayy ibn Kaʿb, who said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: Moses, peace be upon him, stood up to preach among the Children of Israel, and was asked: "Who is the most knowledgeable of people?" He said: "I am the most knowledgeable." So Allah reproached him, since he did not refer knowledge back to Him, and Allah revealed to him: "I have a servant at the meeting of the two seas who is more knowledgeable than you." Moses said: "O my Lord, how can I reach him?" It was said to him: "Carry a fish in a basket, and where you lose the fish, he is there." So he set off, and his young man set off with him, namely Yūshaʿ ibn Nūn, the two of them walking, until they came to a rock, and he saw a man covered, with a garment over him. Moses greeted him, and al-Khaḍir said: "Whence is there peace in your land?"
He said: "I am Moses." He said: "Moses of the Children of Israel?" He said: "Yes." He said: "You are upon a knowledge from the knowledge of Allah which Allah taught you and which I do not know, and I am upon a knowledge from the knowledge of Allah which He taught me and which you do not know."
And al-Bayḍāwī said:
It does not contradict the prophethood of «our master Moses» and his being the bearer of a sacred law that he should learn from another what was not a condition in the chapters of religion; for a messenger should be more knowledgeable than those to whom he is sent in what he is sent with of the principles and branches of religion, not absolutely. Moses observed in this the utmost humility and courtesy: he deemed himself ignorant, asked permission to be his follower, and asked him to guide him and to bestow on him the teaching of some of what Allah had bestowed on him..!
